AI BIJAN Motion - packed source files of this folder. Do not edit by hand.
The skill upload in the Claude app accepts at most 200 files, so the source files are packed here.
`node <skill folder>/new-project.mjs <project folder> --kit=<style>` unpacks them into the project.
Format: per file one line with four '=' signs, the byte length and the path, then exactly that many bytes.

==== 15337 src/kits/characterflow/env/room.data.ts
// Indoor set kit (Node-safe data). A room is a box — back wall at z0, side walls at x0 / x1, the camera
// side (+z) open — with windows and a door cut into the walls and a list of furniture pieces. Room.tsx
// draws a layout; roomEnv() (registry.ts) derives the director's data from it: camera bounds, keep-out
// zones, seats, marks and the light per time of day. A new indoor environment is one more layout here.

import type { V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";
import type { Seat } from "../locomotion/stand.ts";

export type Wall = "back" | "left" | "right";
/** an opening along a wall: back wall → x from a to b, side walls → z from a to b */
export type Opening = { wall: Wall; a: number; b: number; y0: number; y1: number; kind: "window" | "door" };
type XZ = [number, number];
/** yaw = the direction a person using the piece faces (0 = +z, toward the cameras) */
export type Piece =
  | { k: "desk"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; w?: number; d?: number; top?: ("laptop" | "books" | "mug" | "monitor" | "plant")[]; seat?: string; color?: string }
  | { k: "schoolDesk"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; seat?: string }
  | { k: "chair"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; seat?: string; color?: string }
  | { k: "stool"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; seat?: string }
  | { k: "sofa"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; w?: number; seats?: string[]; color?: string }
  | { k: "armchair"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; seat?: string; color?: string }
  | { k: "coffeeTable"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; w?: number; d?: number }
  | { k: "cafeTable"; at: XZ; r?: number; cups?: number }
  | { k: "counter"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; w?: number; d?: number; h?: number; machine?: boolean }
  | { k: "shelf"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; w?: number; h?: number }
  | { k: "board"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; w?: number; h?: number; y?: number; style?: "white" | "chalk" | "menu" }
  | { k: "tv"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; w?: number }
  | { k: "plant"; at: XZ; s?: number }
  | { k: "rug"; at: XZ; w: number; d: number; color: string; yaw?: number }
  | { k: "frame"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; y?: number; w?: number; h?: number; colors?: [string, string, string] }
  | { k: "clock"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; y?: number }
  | { k: "dispenser"; at: XZ; yaw?: number }
  | { k: "cabinet"; at: XZ; yaw?: number; w?: number; h?: number; d?: number; color?: string }
  | { k: "lamp"; at: XZ; y: number; style?: "pendant" | "tube" };

export type RoomLayout = {
  id: string;
  room: { x0: number; x1: number; z0: number; z1: number; h: number };
  openings: Opening[];
  pieces: Piece[];
  marks: Record<string, { pos: V3; yaw: number; what: string }>;
  palette: { wall: string; wallLow?: string; floor: string; floorKind: "wood" | "tile" | "carpet"; trim: string; accent: string; ceiling?: string };
  /** what is seen through the windows by day */
  view: "city" | "garden" | "street";
  /** sound of the room */
  ambience: "room" | "class" | "office" | "cafe";
  /** horizontal direction cameras prefer around a subject (default +z) */
  viewSide?: V3;
  /** a home (people wear socks indoors) */
  home?: boolean;
};

const FW = (yaw: number): XZ => [Math.sin(yaw), Math.cos(yaw)];
const R = (yaw: number, lx: number, lz: number): XZ => [lx * Math.cos(yaw) + lz * Math.sin(yaw), -lx * Math.sin(yaw) + lz * Math.cos(yaw)];

/** Chair offset behind a desk (the sitter faces the desk's yaw). */
export const DESK_CHAIR = 0.62;
export const SEAT_H = { chair: 0.47, stool: 0.62, sofa: 0.45, schoolDesk: 0.45 };

/** Every seat a layout offers (pelvis point on the seat, facing yaw). */
export const roomSeats = (L: RoomLayout): Record<string, Seat> => {
  const out: Record<string, Seat> = {};
  for (const p of L.pieces) {
    const yaw = "yaw" in p && p.yaw !== undefined ? p.yaw : 0;
    const f = FW(yaw);
    if ((p.k === "desk" || p.k === "schoolDesk") && p.seat) {
      const back = p.k === "desk" ? DESK_CHAIR : 0.5;
      out[p.seat] = { pos: [p.at[0] - f[0] * back, 0, p.at[1] - f[1] * back], yaw, height: p.k === "desk" ? SEAT_H.chair : SEAT_H.schoolDesk };
    }
    if ((p.k === "chair" || p.k === "stool") && p.seat) out[p.seat] = { pos: [p.at[0] + f[0] * 0.03, 0, p.at[1] + f[1] * 0.03], yaw, height: p.k === "stool" ? SEAT_H.stool : SEAT_H.chair };
    if (p.k === "armchair" && p.seat) out[p.seat] = { pos: [p.at[0] + f[0] * 0.06, 0, p.at[1] + f[1] * 0.06], yaw, height: SEAT_H.sofa };
    if (p.k === "sofa" && p.seats) {
      const w = p.w ?? 2.0, n = p.seats.length;
      p.seats.forEach((id, i) => {
        const lx = -w / 2 + 0.25 + ((w - 0.5) * (i + 0.5)) / n;
        const o = R(yaw, lx, 0.06);
        out[id] = { pos: [p.at[0] + o[0], 0, p.at[1] + o[1]], yaw, height: SEAT_H.sofa };
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
};

/** Keep-out spheres for cameras: tall furniture and the walls' near zone. */
export const roomBlockers = (L: RoomLayout): { c: V3; r: number }[] => {
  const out: { c: V3; r: number }[] = [];
  for (const p of L.pieces) {
    const [x, z] = p.at;
    switch (p.k) {
      case "shelf": out.push({ c: [x, 1.0, z], r: Math.max(0.55, (p.w ?? 1) * 0.55) }); break;
      case "counter": out.push({ c: [x, 0.6, z], r: 0.6 }); break;
      case "plant": out.push({ c: [x, 0.8, z], r: 0.45 * (p.s ?? 1) }); break;
      case "dispenser": out.push({ c: [x, 0.7, z], r: 0.35 }); break;
      case "cabinet": out.push({ c: [x, (p.h ?? 0.9) / 2, z], r: 0.45 }); break;
      case "desk": out.push({ c: [x, 0.5, z], r: 0.5 }); break;
      case "cafeTable": out.push({ c: [x, 0.5, z], r: 0.4 }); break;
      case "sofa": case "armchair": out.push({ c: [x, 0.45, z], r: 0.55 }); break;
      case "lamp": out.push({ c: [x, p.y, z], r: 0.3 }); break;
      default: break;
    }
  }
  return out;
};

==== 26220 src/kits/characterflow/env/Room.tsx
// Generic indoor set: draws any RoomLayout (room.data.ts) — floor, four walls with window / door openings
// and the view outside, ceiling with lamps, and the furniture pieces. Everything is built from the same
// small parts (rounded boxes, cylinders, spheres) and shared materials, so a new room is data only.

import React from "react";
import { DoubleSide, PlaneGeometry } from "three";
import { box, cached, cyl, sphere } from "../lib/geo.ts";
import { basic, phys, shade } from "../lib/mats.ts";
import { boardTex, carpetTex, paintTex, plankTex, spineColors, tileTex, viewTex } from "./textures.ts";
import { DESK_CHAIR, type Piece, type RoomLayout, type Wall } from "./room.data.ts";
import type { TimeOfDay } from "./registry.ts";

type M = ReturnType<typeof mats>;
const mats = (L: RoomLayout) => {
  const P = L.palette;
  const w = P.wall, rx = L.room.x1 - L.room.x0, rz = L.room.z1 - L.room.z0;
  return {
    wall: phys(`rmwall${L.id}`, { color: "#ffffff", map: paintTex(`rm${L.id}`, w, [3, 2]), roughness: 0.92 }),
    wallLow: phys(`rmwallLow${L.id}`, { color: "#ffffff", map: paintTex(`rmL${L.id}`, P.wallLow ?? w, [3, 1]), roughness: 0.85 }),
    floor: phys(`rmfloor${L.id}`, {
      color: "#ffffff",
      map: P.floorKind === "wood" ? plankTex([rx / 1.6, rz / 3.2], P.floor) : P.floorKind === "tile" ? tileTex(P.floor, [rx / 2, rz / 2]) : carpetTex(P.floor, [rx / 1.2, rz / 1.2]),
      roughness: P.floorKind === "carpet" ? 0.95 : 0.55,
      clearcoat: P.floorKind === "wood" ? 0.2 : P.floorKind === "tile" ? 0.12 : 0,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.45,
    }),
    ceiling: phys(`rmceil${L.id}`, { color: P.ceiling ?? "#e8e5df", roughness: 0.95 }),
    trim: phys(`rmtrim${P.trim}`, { color: P.trim, roughness: 0.45, clearcoat: 0.3 }),
    accent: phys(`rmacc${P.accent}`, { color: P.accent, roughness: 0.6, sheen: 0.4 }),
    wood: phys("rmwood", { color: "#b98b5e", roughness: 0.5, clearcoat: 0.3, clearcoatRoughness: 0.4 }),
    woodDark: phys("rmwoodD", { color: "#6b4a33", roughness: 0.55 }),
    white: phys("rmwhite", { color: "#e4e1db", roughness: 0.4, clearcoat: 0.3 }),
    metal: phys("rmmetal", { color: "#b9bcc2", roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.8 }),
    dark: phys("rmdark", { color: "#2b2d33", roughness: 0.45 }),
    glass: phys("rmglass", { color: "#cfe6f5", roughness: 0.05, transmission: 0.9, thickness: 0.01, transparent: true, opacity: 0.25 }),
    leaf: phys("rmleaf", { color: "#3f8f5a", roughness: 0.6, sheen: 0.4, sheenColor: "#a8e6b8" }),
    pot: phys("rmpot", { color: "#e07a5f", roughness: 0.7 }),
    screen: phys("rmscreen", { color: "#0d1520", emissive: "#7fb2ff", emissiveIntensity: 0.55, roughness: 0.2, clearcoat: 1 }),
  };
};

const T = 0.12; // wall thickness

/** A wall along its own axis from 0 to len, height h, with openings; drawn in local coords (x along, z out). */
const WallMesh: React.FC<{ len: number; h: number; holes: { a: number; b: number; y0: number; y1: number }[]; m: M; split: number; shadow: boolean }> = ({ len, h, holes, m, split, shadow }) => {
  const cuts = [...new Set([0, len, ...holes.flatMap((o) => [o.a, o.b])])].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const out: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < cuts.length - 1; i++) {
    const a = cuts[i], b = cuts[i + 1], mid = (a + b) / 2, w = b - a;
    if (w < 0.005) continue;
    const hole = holes.find((o) => mid > o.a && mid < o.b);
    const spans: [number, number][] = hole ? [[0, hole.y0], [hole.y1, h]] : [[0, h]];
    for (const [y0, y1] of spans) {
      if (y1 - y0 < 0.005) continue;
      // two-tone wall: a lower band up to `split`
      const parts: [number, number, boolean][] = y0 < split && y1 > split ? [[y0, split, true], [split, y1, false]] : [[y0, y1, y0 < split]];
      for (const [p0, p1, low] of parts)
        out.push(<mesh key={`${i}-${p0}`} geometry={box(w, p1 - p0, T, 0.004)} material={low ? m.wallLow : m.wall} position={[mid, (p0 + p1) / 2, 0]} castShadow={shadow} receiveShadow />);
    }
  }
  // a dado rail on two-tone walls
  if (split > 0) out.push(<mesh key="rail" geometry={box(len, 0.04, 0.03, 0.01)} material={m.trim} position={[len / 2, split, T / 2 + 0.01]} />);
  out.push(<mesh key="base" geometry={box(len, 0.09, 0.02, 0.005)} material={m.trim} position={[len / 2, 0.045, T / 2 + 0.01]} />);
  return <>{out}</>;
};

const WindowFrame: React.FC<{ w: number; y0: number; y1: number; m: M; view: RoomLayout["view"]; time: TimeOfDay }> = ({ w, y0, y1, m, view, time }) => {
  const hh = y1 - y0, cy = (y0 + y1) / 2;
  const viewMat = basic(`rmview${view}${time}`, { map: viewTex(view, time), toneMapped: true });
  return (
    <group>
      {[y0, y1, cy].map((y, i) => <mesh key={`h${i}`} geometry={box(w, 0.05, 0.07, 0.01)} material={m.white} position={[w / 2, y, 0.02]} castShadow />)}
      {[0, w, w / 2].map((x, i) => <mesh key={`v${i}`} geometry={box(0.05, hh, 0.07, 0.01)} material={m.white} position={[x, cy, 0.02]} castShadow />)}
      <mesh geometry={box(w + 0.12, 0.04, 0.2, 0.012)} material={m.white} position={[w / 2, y0 - 0.02, 0.1]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={cached(`rmviewplane${w}`, () => new PlaneGeometry(w * 2.2, hh * 2.4))} material={viewMat} position={[w / 2, cy + 0.2, -1.6]} />
    </group>
  );
};

const Door: React.FC<{ w: number; h: number; m: M }> = ({ w, h, m }) => (
  <group>
    <mesh geometry={box(w - 0.06, h - 0.03, 0.05, 0.01)} material={m.woodDark} position={[w / 2, (h - 0.03) / 2, -0.02]} castShadow receiveShadow />
    {[0, w].map((x, i) => <mesh key={i} geometry={box(0.07, h, 0.15, 0.01)} material={m.trim} position={[x, h / 2, 0]} />)}
    <mesh geometry={box(w + 0.07, 0.07, 0.15, 0.01)} material={m.trim} position={[w / 2, h, 0]} />
    <mesh geometry={sphere(0.03, 12, 8)} material={m.metal} position={[w - 0.12, 1.0, 0.03]} />
  </group>
);

// ── furniture ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const Legs: React.FC<{ w: number; d: number; h: number; r?: number; m: React.ComponentProps<"mesh">["material"] }> = ({ w, d, h, r = 0.022, m }) => (
  <>{[[-1, -1], [1, -1], [-1, 1], [1, 1]].map(([sx, sz], i) => <mesh key={i} geometry={cyl(r, r * 0.85, h, 10)} material={m} position={[sx * (w / 2 - 0.05), h / 2, sz * (d / 2 - 0.05)]} castShadow />)}</>
);

const Chair: React.FC<{ color?: string; m: M }> = ({ color = "#6b7a8f", m }) => {
  const c = phys(`rmchair${color}`, { color, roughness: 0.6, sheen: 0.3 });
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={box(0.44, 0.05, 0.42, 0.02)} material={c} position={[0, 0.455, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.44, 0.44, 0.05, 0.02)} material={c} position={[0, 0.72, -0.2]} rotation={[-0.08, 0, 0]} castShadow />
      <Legs w={0.42} d={0.4} h={0.44} r={0.016} m={m.dark} />
    </group>
  );
};

const Laptop: React.FC<{ m: M }> = ({ m }) => (
  <group>
    <mesh geometry={box(0.34, 0.018, 0.24, 0.008)} material={m.metal} position={[0, 0.009, 0]} castShadow />
    <group position={[0, 0.018, 0.12]} rotation={[0.32, 0, 0]}>
      <mesh geometry={box(0.34, 0.23, 0.012, 0.006)} material={m.metal} position={[0, 0.115, 0]} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={cached("rmlapscr", () => new PlaneGeometry(0.31, 0.2))} material={m.screen} position={[0, 0.118, -0.0065]} rotation={[0, Math.PI, 0]} />
    </group>
  </group>
);

const Books: React.FC<{ n?: number }> = ({ n = 4 }) => (
  <>{Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => <mesh key={k} geometry={box(0.24, 0.04, 0.17, 0.006)} material={phys(`rmbook${k}`, { color: spineColors[k % spineColors.length], roughness: 0.6 })} position={[0, 0.02 + k * 0.041, 0]} rotation={[0, 0.15 * (k % 2 ? 1 : -1), 0]} castShadow />)}</>
);
const Mug: React.FC<{ m: M; color?: string }> = ({ m, color }) => (
  <mesh geometry={cyl(0.04, 0.035, 0.095, 18)} material={color ? phys(`rmmug${color}`, { color, roughness: 0.35, clearcoat: 0.5 }) : m.white} position={[0, 0.048, 0]} castShadow />
);
const SmallPlant: React.FC<{ m: M }> = ({ m }) => (
  <group>
    <mesh geometry={cyl(0.06, 0.045, 0.1, 18)} material={m.pot} position={[0, 0.05, 0]} castShadow />
    {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((k) => <mesh key={k} geometry={sphere(0.05, 12, 8)} material={m.leaf} position={[0.05 * Math.cos(k * 1.3), 0.14 + 0.025 * (k % 2), 0.05 * Math.sin(k * 1.3)]} scale={[1, 0.5, 0.7]} rotation={[0.3 * k, k, 0.5]} castShadow />)}
  </group>
);

const PieceView: React.FC<{ p: Piece; m: M; night: boolean }> = ({ p, m, night }) => {
  const yaw = "yaw" in p && p.yaw !== undefined ? p.yaw : 0;
  const at: [number, number, number] = [p.at[0], 0, p.at[1]];
  switch (p.k) {
    case "desk": {
      const w = p.w ?? 1.2, d = p.d ?? 0.6, top = p.top ?? [];
      const mat = phys(`rmdesk${p.color ?? "w"}`, { color: p.color ?? "#b98b5e", roughness: 0.45, clearcoat: 0.3 });
      const slots = [-w / 2 + 0.25, w / 2 - 0.22, 0.05];
      return (
        <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={box(w, 0.04, d, 0.012)} material={mat} position={[0, 0.74, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <Legs w={w} d={d} h={0.72} m={m.dark} />
          <mesh geometry={box(w - 0.12, 0.3, 0.02, 0.006)} material={mat} position={[0, 0.55, d / 2 - 0.04]} castShadow />
          {top.map((it, i) => (
            <group key={i} position={[it === "laptop" ? -w / 2 + 0.3 : slots[(i + 1) % 2], 0.76, it === "laptop" ? -0.06 : 0.05]} rotation={[0, it === "laptop" ? Math.PI - 0.45 : 0.3, 0]}>
              {it === "laptop" ? <Laptop m={m} /> : it === "books" ? <Books n={3} /> : it === "mug" ? <Mug m={m} color="#e76f51" /> : it === "plant" ? <SmallPlant m={m} /> : (
                <group>
                  <mesh geometry={box(0.52, 0.32, 0.03, 0.01)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0.3, 0.1]} castShadow />
                  <mesh geometry={cached("rmmonscr", () => new PlaneGeometry(0.48, 0.28))} material={m.screen} position={[0, 0.3, 0.084]} rotation={[0, Math.PI, 0]} />
                  <mesh geometry={cyl(0.015, 0.015, 0.15, 8)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0.08, 0.1]} />
                  <mesh geometry={box(0.2, 0.015, 0.15, 0.005)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0.008, 0.1]} />
                </group>
              )}
            </group>
          ))}
          {p.seat ? <group position={[0, 0, -DESK_CHAIR]}><Chair m={m} color="#2f3542" /></group> : null}
        </group>
      );
    }
    case "schoolDesk":
      return (
        <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={box(0.62, 0.035, 0.45, 0.01)} material={m.wood} position={[0, 0.71, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={box(0.58, 0.012, 0.4, 0.004)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0.62, 0]} castShadow />
          <Legs w={0.6} d={0.43} h={0.7} r={0.015} m={m.metal} />
          <group position={[0, 0, -0.5]}><Chair m={m} color="#3e7cb1" /></group>
        </group>
      );
    case "chair":
      return <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}><Chair m={m} color={p.color} /></group>;
    case "stool":
      return (
        <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.19, 0.19, 0.05, 24)} material={m.woodDark} position={[0, 0.62, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.025, 0.025, 0.6, 10)} material={m.metal} position={[0, 0.3, 0]} castShadow />
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.18, 0.2, 0.025, 24)} material={m.metal} position={[0, 0.012, 0]} />
        </group>
      );
    case "sofa": case "armchair": {
      const w = p.k === "sofa" ? p.w ?? 2.0 : 0.95;
      const c = phys(`rmsofa${p.color}`, { color: p.color ?? "#5b7fa6", roughness: 0.85, sheen: 0.7, sheenColor: shade(p.color ?? "#5b7fa6", 1.6) });
      const n = p.k === "sofa" ? Math.max(2, (p.seats ?? []).length || 2) : 1;
      return (
        <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={box(w, 0.3, 0.85, 0.06)} material={c} position={[0, 0.22, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={box(w, 0.55, 0.2, 0.08)} material={c} position={[0, 0.6, -0.33]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          {[-1, 1].map((s) => <mesh key={s} geometry={box(0.18, 0.5, 0.85, 0.07)} material={c} position={[s * (w / 2 - 0.09), 0.37, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />)}
          {Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => {
            const cw = (w - 0.36) / n;
            return <mesh key={i} geometry={box(cw - 0.03, 0.12, 0.62, 0.05)} material={c} position={[-w / 2 + 0.18 + cw * (i + 0.5), 0.41, 0.08]} castShadow receiveShadow />;
          })}
          {p.k === "sofa" ? <mesh geometry={box(0.42, 0.36, 0.13, 0.06)} material={m.accent} position={[w / 2 - 0.42, 0.62, -0.18]} rotation={[-0.2, -0.15, 0.04]} castShadow /> : null}
          <Legs w={w - 0.1} d={0.75} h={0.07} r={0.025} m={m.woodDark} />
        </group>
      );
    }
    case "coffeeTable": {
      const w = p.w ?? 1.0, d = p.d ?? 0.55;
      return (
        <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={box(w, 0.05, d, 0.015)} material={m.wood} position={[0, 0.42, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={box(w - 0.1, 0.03, d - 0.1, 0.01)} material={m.woodDark} position={[0, 0.14, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <Legs w={w} d={d} h={0.41} r={0.02} m={m.woodDark} />
          <group position={[0.22, 0.445, 0.05]}><Mug m={m} color="#2a9d8f" /></group>
          <group position={[-0.25, 0.445, -0.04]}><Books n={2} /></group>
        </group>
      );
    }
    case "cafeTable": {
      const r = p.r ?? 0.36;
      return (
        <group position={at}>
          <mesh geometry={cyl(r, r, 0.035, 40)} material={m.wood} position={[0, 0.74, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.03, 0.03, 0.72, 10)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0.37, 0]} castShadow />
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.22, 0.24, 0.025, 24)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0.012, 0]} />
          {Array.from({ length: p.cups ?? 0 }, (_, i) => (
            <group key={i} position={[(i ? 1 : -1) * r * 0.45, 0.76, (i ? -0.06 : 0.05)]}>
              <mesh geometry={cyl(0.07, 0.07, 0.008, 20)} material={m.white} position={[0, 0.004, 0]} />
              <mesh geometry={cyl(0.042, 0.034, 0.075, 18)} material={m.white} position={[0, 0.045, 0]} castShadow />
              <mesh geometry={cyl(0.037, 0.037, 0.004, 18)} material={phys("rmcoffee", { color: "#5a3a22", roughness: 0.2, clearcoat: 1 })} position={[0, 0.078, 0]} />
            </group>
          ))}
        </group>
      );
    }
    case "counter": {
      const w = p.w ?? 3, d = p.d ?? 0.6, h = p.h ?? 1.0;
      return (
        <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={box(w, h - 0.05, d, 0.02)} material={m.woodDark} position={[0, (h - 0.05) / 2, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={box(w + 0.08, 0.05, d + 0.1, 0.012)} material={phys("rmcountertop", { color: "#e8e1d6", roughness: 0.25, clearcoat: 0.6 })} position={[0, h - 0.025, 0.02]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          {Array.from({ length: Math.floor(w / 0.5) }, (_, i) => <mesh key={i} geometry={box(0.42, h - 0.2, 0.01, 0.004)} material={m.wood} position={[-w / 2 + 0.27 + i * 0.5, (h - 0.05) / 2, d / 2 + 0.004]} />)}
          {p.machine ? (
            <group position={[w / 2 - 0.6, h, -0.05]}>
              <mesh geometry={box(0.55, 0.42, 0.4, 0.04)} material={phys("rmespresso", { color: "#c0392b", roughness: 0.25, clearcoat: 0.8 })} position={[0, 0.21, 0]} castShadow />
              <mesh geometry={box(0.5, 0.05, 0.38, 0.01)} material={m.metal} position={[0, 0.445, 0]} castShadow />
              {[-0.12, 0.12].map((x) => <mesh key={x} geometry={cyl(0.03, 0.03, 0.08, 12)} material={m.metal} position={[x, 0.12, 0.22]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />)}
              {[0, 1, 2].map((k) => <mesh key={k} geometry={cyl(0.04, 0.034, 0.08, 16)} material={m.white} position={[-0.15 + k * 0.15, 0.49, 0]} castShadow />)}
            </group>
          ) : null}
          <group position={[-w / 2 + 0.5, h, 0.05]}>
            <mesh geometry={box(0.3, 0.2, 0.25, 0.03)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0.1, 0]} castShadow />
            <mesh geometry={box(0.26, 0.14, 0.02, 0.01)} material={m.screen} position={[0, 0.27, 0.02]} rotation={[-0.4, 0, 0]} />
          </group>
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.16, 0.12, 0.12, 24, true)} material={phys("rmjar", { color: "#f3ead8", roughness: 0.1, transmission: 0.6, transparent: true, opacity: 0.6, side: DoubleSide })} position={[-w / 2 + 1.1, h + 0.06, 0.05]} />
        </group>
      );
    }
    case "shelf": {
      const w = p.w ?? 1.0, h = p.h ?? 1.9, d = 0.32, rows = Math.max(2, Math.round(h / 0.42));
      return (
        <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          {[-1, 1].map((s) => <mesh key={s} geometry={box(0.03, h, d, 0.008)} material={m.wood} position={[s * (w / 2 - 0.015), h / 2, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />)}
          <mesh geometry={box(w, h, 0.02, 0.005)} material={m.woodDark} position={[0, h / 2, -d / 2 + 0.01]} receiveShadow />
          {Array.from({ length: rows + 1 }, (_, r) => <mesh key={r} geometry={box(w, 0.025, d, 0.006)} material={m.wood} position={[0, 0.03 + (r * (h - 0.06)) / rows, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />)}
          {Array.from({ length: rows }, (_, r) =>
            Array.from({ length: Math.floor((w - 0.1) / 0.05) }, (_, k) => (k * 7 + r * 3) % 11 === 0 ? null : (
              <mesh key={`${r}-${k}`} geometry={box(0.04, 0.22 + ((k + r) % 3) * 0.04, 0.2, 0.005)} material={phys(`rmspine${(k + r) % 8}`, { color: spineColors[(k + r) % 8], roughness: 0.65 })} position={[-w / 2 + 0.07 + k * 0.05, 0.045 + (r * (h - 0.06)) / rows + 0.11 + ((k + r) % 3) * 0.02, 0.02]} castShadow />
            )))}
        </group>
      );
    }
    case "board": {
      const w = p.w ?? 2.4, h = p.h ?? 1.2, y = p.y ?? 0.95, st = p.style ?? "white";
      return (
        <group position={[at[0], y, at[2]]} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={box(w + 0.08, h + 0.08, 0.03, 0.01)} material={st === "white" ? m.metal : m.woodDark} position={[0, h / 2, 0.015]} castShadow />
          <mesh geometry={cached(`rmboard${w},${h}`, () => new PlaneGeometry(w, h))} material={phys(`rmboard${st}`, { map: boardTex(st), roughness: st === "white" ? 0.25 : 0.9, clearcoat: st === "white" ? 0.6 : 0 })} position={[0, h / 2, 0.032]} />
          {st === "white" ? <mesh geometry={box(w * 0.6, 0.03, 0.07, 0.008)} material={m.metal} position={[0, -0.02, 0.05]} /> : null}
        </group>
      );
    }
    case "tv": {
      const w = p.w ?? 1.2;
      return (
        <group position={[at[0], 0.5, at[2]]} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={box(w, w * 0.58, 0.05, 0.01)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0.42, 0.04]} castShadow />
          <mesh geometry={cached(`rmtvscr${w}`, () => new PlaneGeometry(w - 0.04, w * 0.58 - 0.04))} material={night ? phys("rmtvon", { color: "#0d1520", emissive: "#5a8fd8", emissiveIntensity: 0.35, roughness: 0.2 }) : phys("rmtvoff", { color: "#11151c", roughness: 0.15, clearcoat: 1 })} position={[0, 0.42, 0.066]} />
          <mesh geometry={box(0.3, 0.02, 0.18, 0.005)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0.02, 0.04]} />
        </group>
      );
    }
    case "plant": {
      const s = p.s ?? 1;
      return (
        <group position={at} scale={[s, s, s]}>
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.18, 0.14, 0.38, 24)} material={m.pot} position={[0, 0.19, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, k) => <mesh key={k} geometry={sphere(0.17, 16, 10)} material={m.leaf} position={[0.19 * Math.cos(k * 2.4), 0.55 + 0.09 * k, 0.19 * Math.sin(k * 2.4)]} scale={[1, 0.22, 0.62]} rotation={[0.4 * Math.sin(k), k * 2.4, 0.35]} castShadow />)}
        </group>
      );
    }
    case "rug":
      return <mesh geometry={cached(`rmrug${p.w},${p.d}`, () => new PlaneGeometry(p.w, p.d))} material={phys(`rmrug${p.color}`, { color: p.color, roughness: 0.97, sheen: 0.6, sheenColor: "#ffffff" })} position={[at[0], 0.006, at[2]]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, yaw]} receiveShadow />;
    case "frame": {
      const w = p.w ?? 0.5, h = p.h ?? 0.6, [a, b, c] = p.colors ?? ["#f4a261", "#2a9d8f", "#264653"];
      return (
        <group position={[at[0], p.y ?? 1.6, at[2]]} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={box(w, h, 0.03, 0.006)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0, 0.015]} castShadow />
          <mesh geometry={box(w - 0.06, h - 0.06, 0.01, 0.003)} material={phys(`rmart${a}`, { color: a, roughness: 0.7 })} position={[0, 0, 0.032]} />
          <mesh geometry={sphere(Math.min(w, h) * 0.22, 20, 12)} material={phys(`rmart${b}`, { color: b, roughness: 0.7 })} position={[-w * 0.12, h * 0.08, 0.035]} scale={[1, 1, 0.05]} />
          <mesh geometry={box(w - 0.08, h * 0.25, 0.01, 0.003)} material={phys(`rmart${c}`, { color: c, roughness: 0.7 })} position={[0, -h * 0.28, 0.038]} />
        </group>
      );
    }
    case "clock":
      return (
        <group position={[at[0], p.y ?? 2.2, at[2]]} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.17, 0.17, 0.04, 40)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0, 0.02]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} castShadow />
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.15, 0.15, 0.01, 40)} material={m.white} position={[0, 0, 0.042]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
          <mesh geometry={box(0.012, 0.1, 0.006, 0.002)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0.045, 0.05]} />
          <mesh geometry={box(0.07, 0.012, 0.006, 0.002)} material={m.dark} position={[0.03, 0, 0.05]} />
        </group>
      );
    case "dispenser":
      return (
        <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={box(0.32, 1.0, 0.32, 0.03)} material={m.white} position={[0, 0.5, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.13, 0.13, 0.4, 24)} material={phys("rmgallon", { color: "#9fd3f5", roughness: 0.05, transmission: 0.7, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7 })} position={[0, 1.2, 0]} castShadow />
          {[-0.06, 0.06].map((x, i) => <mesh key={i} geometry={box(0.04, 0.05, 0.04, 0.01)} material={phys(`rmtap${i}`, { color: i ? "#2b6cb0" : "#c0392b", roughness: 0.4 })} position={[x, 0.78, 0.17]} />)}
        </group>
      );
    case "cabinet": {
      const w = p.w ?? 1.0, h = p.h ?? 0.9, d = p.d ?? 0.45;
      const c = phys(`rmcab${p.color}`, { color: p.color ?? "#d9d4cc", roughness: 0.5, clearcoat: 0.3 });
      return (
        <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={box(w, h, d, 0.02)} material={c} position={[0, h / 2, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          {[-1, 1].map((s) => <mesh key={s} geometry={box(0.012, h * 0.5, 0.012, 0.004)} material={m.metal} position={[s * 0.05, h * 0.55, d / 2 + 0.01]} />)}
        </group>
      );
    }
    case "lamp": {
      const on = night ? 1 : 0.35;
      const bulb = basic(`rmbulb${on}`, { color: "#fff2d6", toneMapped: false });
      bulb.color.setRGB(0.5 + 1.4 * on, 0.45 + 1.15 * on, 0.36 + 0.85 * on);
      if (p.style === "tube")
        return (
          <group position={[at[0], p.y, at[2]]}>
            <mesh geometry={box(1.2, 0.05, 0.2, 0.015)} material={m.white} position={[0, -0.025, 0]} />
            <mesh geometry={box(1.12, 0.02, 0.14, 0.008)} material={bulb} position={[0, -0.055, 0]} />
          </group>
        );
      return (
        <group position={[at[0], p.y, at[2]]}>
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.006, 0.006, 0.6, 6)} material={m.dark} position={[0, 0.3, 0]} />
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.06, 0.2, 0.2, 32, true)} material={phys("rmshade", { color: "#2b2d33", roughness: 0.5, side: DoubleSide })} position={[0, -0.05, 0]} castShadow />
          <mesh geometry={sphere(0.05, 16, 10)} material={bulb} position={[0, -0.1, 0]} />
        </group>
      );
    }
  }
};

/** Window / door openings of one wall in its own along-wall coordinate (0 at the wall's start). */
const holesOf = (L: RoomLayout, wall: Wall, start: number, flip: boolean) =>
  L.openings.filter((o) => o.wall === wall).map((o) => (flip ? { a: start - o.b, b: start - o.a, y0: o.y0, y1: o.y1, o } : { a: o.a - start, b: o.b - start, y0: o.y0, y1: o.y1, o }));

export const Room: React.FC<{ L: RoomLayout; time: TimeOfDay }> = ({ L, time }) => {
  const m = mats(L);
  const { x0, x1, z0, z1, h } = L.room;
  const night = time === "night";
  const split = L.palette.wallLow && L.palette.wallLow !== L.palette.wall ? 1.0 : 0;
  const lenX = x1 - x0, lenZ = z1 - z0;
  // back wall runs +x from x0; left wall runs −z from z1 (seen from inside: left to right); right wall +z
  const back = holesOf(L, "back", x0, false), left = holesOf(L, "left", z1, true), right = holesOf(L, "right", z0, false);
  const openings = (hs: ReturnType<typeof holesOf>) => hs.map((x, i) => (
    <group key={i} position={[x.a, x.o.kind === "window" ? 0 : 0, 0]}>
      {x.o.kind === "window" ? <WindowFrame w={x.b - x.a} y0={x.y0} y1={x.y1} m={m} view={L.view} time={time} /> : <Door w={x.b - x.a} h={x.y1} m={m} />}
    </group>
  ));
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={box(lenX + 0.4, 0.06, lenZ + 0.4, 0.01)} material={m.floor} position={[(x0 + x1) / 2, -0.03, (z0 + z1) / 2]} receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={box(lenX + 0.3, 0.06, lenZ + 0.3, 0.01)} material={m.ceiling} position={[(x0 + x1) / 2, h + 0.03, (z0 + z1) / 2]} />
      <group position={[x0, 0, z0 - T / 2]}>
        <WallMesh len={lenX} h={h} holes={back} m={m} split={split} shadow />
        {openings(back)}
      </group>
      <group position={[x0 - T / 2, 0, z1]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]}>
        <WallMesh len={lenZ} h={h} holes={left} m={m} split={split} shadow />
        {openings(left)}
      </group>
      <group position={[x1 + T / 2, 0, z0]} rotation={[0, -Math.PI / 2, 0]}>
        <WallMesh len={lenZ} h={h} holes={right} m={m} split={split} shadow />
        {openings(right)}
      </group>
      {/* the camera-side wall: plain, casts no shadow (it would darken the set) */}
      <group position={[x1, 0, z1 + T / 2]} rotation={[0, Math.PI, 0]}>
        <WallMesh len={lenX} h={h} holes={[]} m={m} split={split} shadow={false} />
      </group>
      {L.pieces.map((p, i) => <PieceView key={i} p={p} m={m} night={night} />)}
    </group>
  );
};

==== 12928 src/kits/characterflow/env/textures.ts
// Procedural textures for the environment kit (seeded, file-free).

import { canvasTex, mulberry32, shade } from "../lib/mats.ts";

/** Warm oak plank floor. */
export const plankTex = (rep: [number, number], base = "#a77b55") =>
  canvasTex(`cfplank${rep}${base}`, 512, 1024, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(11);
    const pw = w / 4;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      let y = -r() * 300;
      while (y < h) {
        const len = 380 + r() * 320;
        g.fillStyle = shade(base, 0.84 + r() * 0.28);
        g.fillRect(i * pw, y, pw, len);
        for (let k = 0; k < 22; k++) {
          g.strokeStyle = `rgba(70,40,20,${0.05 + r() * 0.08})`;
          g.lineWidth = 0.6 + r() * 1.5;
          const x = i * pw + r() * pw;
          g.beginPath();
          g.moveTo(x, y);
          g.bezierCurveTo(x + (r() - 0.5) * 12, y + len * 0.3, x + (r() - 0.5) * 12, y + len * 0.7, x + (r() - 0.5) * 8, y + len);
          g.stroke();
        }
        g.fillStyle = "rgba(40,24,14,0.5)";
        g.fillRect(i * pw, y, pw, 2);
        y += len;
      }
      g.fillStyle = "rgba(40,24,14,0.45)";
      g.fillRect(i * pw, 0, 2, h);
    }
  }, rep);

/** Matte painted wall with a faint roller texture. */
export const paintTex = (key: string, color: string, rep: [number, number]) =>
  canvasTex(`cfpaint${key}`, 256, 256, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(5);
    g.fillStyle = color;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    for (let k = 0; k < 1400; k++) {
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(${r() > 0.5 ? "255,255,255" : "0,0,0"},${0.012 + r() * 0.02})`;
      g.fillRect(r() * w, r() * h, 1 + r() * 3, 1 + r() * 3);
    }
  }, rep);

/** Duvet cover: soft cotton with a small scattered star print. */
export const duvetTex = (key: string, base: string, ink: string, rep: [number, number]) =>
  canvasTex(`cfduvet${key}`, 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(23);
    g.fillStyle = base;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 3) {
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.025 + r() * 0.02})`;
      g.fillRect(0, y, w, 1);
    }
    g.fillStyle = ink;
    for (let k = 0; k < 46; k++) {
      const x = r() * w, y = r() * h, s = 5 + r() * 6;
      g.save();
      g.translate(x, y);
      g.rotate(r() * Math.PI);
      g.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const a = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2, rr = i % 2 ? s * 0.45 : s;
        g.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * rr, Math.sin(a) * rr);
      }
      g.closePath();
      g.globalAlpha = 0.55 + r() * 0.3;
      g.fill();
      g.restore();
    }
  }, rep);

/** Round braided rug. */
export const rugTex = () =>
  canvasTex("cfrug", 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {
    const cols = ["#e9dcc4", "#d7b98f", "#e9dcc4", "#9fbcc9", "#e9dcc4", "#e3a46f"];
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      g.fillStyle = cols[i % cols.length];
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(w / 2, h / 2, (w / 2) * (1 - i / 30), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
      g.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.08)";
      g.lineWidth = 2;
      g.stroke();
    }
  });

/** Night sky seen through the window: gradient, stars, moon, distant rooftops. */
export const skyTex = () =>
  canvasTex("cfsky", 1024, 1024, (g, w, h) => {
    const gr = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
    gr.addColorStop(0, "#0b1a3d");
    gr.addColorStop(0.6, "#1d3a6e");
    gr.addColorStop(1, "#3b5f8f");
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const r = mulberry32(31);
    for (let k = 0; k < 220; k++) {
      const a = 0.25 + r() * 0.75;
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(230,240,255,${a})`;
      const s = r() < 0.1 ? 2.4 : 1.2;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(r() * w, r() * h * 0.75, s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }
    const mx = w * 0.62, my = h * 0.26, mr = 70;
    const halo = g.createRadialGradient(mx, my, mr * 0.8, mx, my, mr * 4);
    halo.addColorStop(0, "rgba(220,235,255,0.5)");
    halo.addColorStop(1, "rgba(220,235,255,0)");
    g.fillStyle = halo;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    g.fillStyle = "#f4f6ff";
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(mx, my, mr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = "rgba(170,185,215,0.35)";
    for (const [dx, dy, rr] of [[-20, -10, 16], [18, 22, 11], [24, -26, 8], [-8, 30, 7]]) {
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(mx + dx, my + dy, rr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }
    // rooftops
    g.fillStyle = "#0a1428";
    let x = 0;
    while (x < w) {
      const bw = 60 + r() * 140, bh = 90 + r() * 170;
      g.fillRect(x, h - bh, bw, bh);
      if (r() < 0.5) {
        g.beginPath();
        g.moveTo(x - 6, h - bh);
        g.lineTo(x + bw / 2, h - bh - 50);
        g.lineTo(x + bw + 6, h - bh);
        g.fill();
      }
      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++)
        if (r() < 0.35) {
          g.fillStyle = r() < 0.5 ? "#ffcf86" : "#ffe4b0";
          g.fillRect(x + 10 + r() * (bw - 30), h - bh + 20 + r() * (bh - 40), 12, 16);
          g.fillStyle = "#0a1428";
        }
      x += bw + 4;
    }
  });

/** Poster: soft mountains at dusk. */
export const posterTex = (key: string, a: string, b: string, c: string) =>
  canvasTex(`cfposter${key}`, 256, 340, (g, w, h) => {

    g.lineTo(w - m, h - m);

    g.lineTo(w * 0.5, h * 0.82);
    g.lineTo(w - m, h * 0.76);
    g.lineTo(w - m, h - m);
    g.fill();
  });

/** Square floor tiles with grout and a faint speckle (classrooms, shops). */
export const tileTex = (base: string, rep: [number, number]) =>

/** Office carpet tiles: soft fibre noise, tiles turned 90° from each other. */
export const carpetTex = (base: string, rep: [number, number]) =>
  canvasTex(`cfcarpet${base}${rep}`, 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(9);
    const n = 2, s = w / n;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        g.fillStyle = shade(base, (i + j) % 2 ? 0.95 : 1.03);
        g.fillRect(i * s, j * s, s, s);
        for (let k = 0; k < 900; k++) {
          g.fillStyle = `rgba(${r() < 0.5 ? "255,255,255" : "0,0,0"},${0.03 + r() * 0.05})`;
          const horiz = (i + j) % 2 === 0;
          g.fillRect(i * s + r() * s, j * s + r() * s, horiz ? 6 : 1.5, horiz ? 1.5 : 6);
        }
      }
    g.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.12)";
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) { g.fillRect(i * s - 1, 0, 2, h); g.fillRect(0, i * s - 1, w, 2); }
  }, rep);

/** Whiteboard (marker diagram + lines), chalkboard, or a café chalk menu. */
export const boardTex = (style: "white" | "chalk" | "menu") =>
  canvasTex(`cfboard${style}`, 1024, 512, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(style === "white" ? 3 : 4);
    g.fillStyle = style === "white" ? "#f7f8f6" : style === "chalk" ? "#2f4a3a" : "#26231f";
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const ink = style === "white" ? ["#1d4e89", "#c0392b", "#2c3e50"] : ["#f4f1e8", "#f6d55c", "#f4f1e8"];
    g.lineCap = "round";
    if (style === "menu") {
      g.fillStyle = "#f4f1e8";
      g.font = "700 64px sans-serif";
      g.textAlign = "center";
      g.fillText("MENU", w / 2, 86);
      g.font = "500 36px sans-serif";
      g.textAlign = "left";
      const items = ["KOPI SUSU", "AMERICANO", "LATTE", "TEH TARIK", "MATCHA", "ROTI BAKAR"];
      items.forEach((it, i) => {
        const x = i < 3 ? 70 : w / 2 + 40, y = 170 + (i % 3) * 100;
        g.fillStyle = "#f4f1e8";
        g.fillText(it, x, y);
        g.fillStyle = "#f6d55c";
        g.fillText(`${18 + i * 3}K`, x + 300, y);
      });
      return;
    }
    // a little diagram: boxes, arrows, handwriting lines
    for (let b = 0; b < 3; b++) {
      g.strokeStyle = ink[b % ink.length];
      g.lineWidth = 6;
      const x = 90 + b * 300, y = 90 + (b % 2) * 50;
      g.strokeRect(x, y, 200, 110);
      for (let l = 0; l < 3; l++) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x + 20, y + 30 + l * 28); g.lineTo(x + 60 + r() * 120, y + 30 + l * 28 + (r() - 0.5) * 6); g.stroke(); }
      if (b < 2) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x + 210, y + 55); g.lineTo(x + 285, y + 75 - (b % 2) * 40); g.stroke(); }
    }
    g.strokeStyle = ink[2];
    g.lineWidth = 5;
    for (let l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
      g.beginPath();
      let x = 90;
      g.moveTo(x, 330 + l * 42);
      while (x < 90 + 500 + r() * 300) { x += 14 + r() * 26; g.lineTo(x, 330 + l * 42 + (r() - 0.5) * 10); }
      g.stroke();
    }
  });

/** What is seen through a window: city, garden or a street, by day / at sunset / at night. */
export const viewTex = (view: "city" | "garden" | "street", time: "day" | "night" | "sunset") =>
  canvasTex(`cfview${view}${time}`, 1024, 512, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(view === "city" ? 21 : view === "garden" ? 22 : 23);
    const night = time === "night", sun = time === "sunset";
    const sky = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
    sky.addColorStop(0, night ? "#0b1a3d" : sun ? "#f3a66b" : "#7fb8ec");
    sky.addColorStop(1, night ? "#2a4572" : sun ? "#ffd9a8" : "#d6ecfb");
    g.fillStyle = sky;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    if (!night) for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
      g.fillStyle = sun ? "rgba(255,236,214,0.55)" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.75)";
      const cx = r() * w, cy = 40 + r() * 120;
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) { g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(cx + k * 34, cy + (k % 2) * 8, 46, 22, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill(); }
    }
    const lit = (x: number, y: number, ww: number, hh: number) => { g.fillStyle = night ? (r() < 0.55 ? "#ffd48a" : "#1b2a44") : sun ? "#f7c48c" : "#bcd7ee"; g.fillRect(x, y, ww, hh); };
    if (view === "city") {
      for (let layer = 0; layer < 2; layer++) {
        let x = -20;
        while (x < w) {
          const bw = 70 + r() * 120, bh = (layer ? 160 : 230) + r() * 160;
          g.fillStyle = night ? (layer ? "#13203a" : "#0c1628") : layer ? "#9fb3c8" : "#7d93ab";
          g.fillRect(x, h - bh, bw, bh);
          for (let yy = h - bh + 14; yy < h - 10; yy += 22) for (let xx = x + 8; xx < x + bw - 12; xx += 18) if (r() < 0.8) lit(xx, yy, 9, 12);
          x += bw + 6;
        }
      }
    } else if (view === "garden") {
      g.fillStyle = night ? "#0f1d14" : sun ? "#8a8a4a" : "#7cbf6a";
      g.fillRect(0, h * 0.72, w, h * 0.28);
      for (let k = 0; k < 9; k++) {
        const x = r() * w, s = 60 + r() * 70;
        g.fillStyle = night ? "#0b160f" : "#5b4030";
        g.fillRect(x - 6, h * 0.72 - s * 0.9, 12, s);
        g.fillStyle = night ? "#10241a" : sun ? "#6f7a3a" : ["#3f9a54", "#4fae5b", "#2f7d44"][k % 3];
        g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, h * 0.72 - s, s * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();
      }
      g.fillStyle = night ? "#2a2a2a" : "#f1ede4";
      for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 26) g.fillRect(x, h * 0.78, 8, 70);
      g.fillRect(0, h * 0.8, w, 8);
    } else {
      // street: shopfronts across a road
      g.fillStyle = night ? "#1a1a22" : "#6b6f78";
      g.fillRect(0, h * 0.8, w, h * 0.2);
      g.fillStyle = night ? "#c9b45a" : "#f2f2f2";
      for (let x = 10; x < w; x += 90) g.fillRect(x, h * 0.9, 46, 5);
      let x = 0;
      const cols = ["#e8c39e", "#a8c5da", "#e9a1a1", "#c7d9b5", "#f1d6a4"];
      while (x < w) {
        const bw = 150 + r() * 90, bh = 220 + r() * 90;
        g.fillStyle = night ? "#1d2333" : cols[Math.floor(r() * cols.length)];
        g.fillRect(x, h * 0.8 - bh, bw, bh);
        g.fillStyle = night ? "#ffcf7a" : "#3b4a5a";
        g.fillRect(x + 16, h * 0.8 - 110, bw - 32, 90);
        g.fillStyle = night ? "#ff8f5a" : ["#d1495b", "#00798c", "#edae49"][Math.floor(r() * 3)];
        g.fillRect(x + 10, h * 0.8 - 140, bw - 20, 24);
        for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) lit(x + 24 + k * (bw / 2 - 10), h * 0.8 - bh + 30, 40, 50);
        x += bw + 8;
      }
    }
  });

==== 1778 src/kits/characterflow/Films.tsx
import React from "react";
import { Composition } from "remotion";
import { PRESETS } from "../../core/film/frame.ts";
import { STORIES } from "../../stories/registry.ts";
import { CharLook, CARDS } from "./look/CharLook.tsx";
import { StoryFilm, productionOf } from "./director/StoryFilm.tsx";

// CHARACTER FLOW compositions. scripts/make.mjs adds <CharacterFlowFilms /> to src/Root.tsx once; every story in
// src/stories/data is then registered twice: <id>-preview (540 × 960 @ 30, with the mix) and <id>-final
// (1080 × 1920 @ 60, muted — render-final lays the mastered mix in).
const { preview, final } = PRESETS;

export const CharacterFlowFilms: React.FC = () => (
  <>
    {STORIES.map((s) => {
      // a story that does not compile (being edited, a typo) is left out instead of breaking every other story's render
      let d: number;
      try { d = productionOf(s).duration; } catch (e) { console.warn(`story "${s.id}" skipped: ${(e as Error).message.split("\n")[0]}`); return null; }
      return (
        <React.Fragment key={s.id}>
          <Composition id={`${s.id}-preview`} component={StoryFilm} defaultProps={{ story: s, audio: `audio/${s.id}-mix.wav` }} durationInFrames={Math.round(d * preview.fps)} fps={preview.fps} width={preview.width} height={preview.height} />
          <Composition id={`${s.id}-final`} component={StoryFilm} defaultProps={{ story: s }} durationInFrames={Math.round(d * final.fps)} fps={final.fps} width={final.width} height={final.height} />
        </React.Fragment>
      );
    })}
    {/* character proof sheet: every look, expression and gesture */}
    <Composition id="CharacterFlowLook" component={CharLook} durationInFrames={CARDS.length} fps={preview.fps} width={preview.width} height={preview.height} />
  </>
);

==== 5441 src/kits/characterflow/fx/comedy.tsx
// Comedy props for CHARACTERFLOW: a scoreboard that springs out of the ground (any "competition"
// joke), and a tumbleweed for awkward silences. Text comes from the topic.

import React from "react";
import { PlaneGeometry } from "three";
import { box, cached, cyl, lathe, sphere, torus } from "../lib/geo.ts";
import { canvasTex, hash1, phys } from "../lib/mats.ts";
import { FONT } from "../../../core/type/fonts.ts";
import type { V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";

const springUp = (x: number) => {
  if (x <= 0) return 0;
  if (x >= 1) return 1;
  return 1 - Math.exp(-6 * x) * Math.cos(9 * x);
};

export type BoardFace = { kicker: string; title: string; left?: string; right?: string };

const boardTex = (f: BoardFace) =>
  canvasTex(`cfboard${f.kicker}${f.title}${f.left}${f.right}`, 1024, 640, (g, w, h) => {
    g.fillStyle = "#1d2a4d";
    g.beginPath();
    g.roundRect(0, 0, w, h, 40);
    g.fill();
    // marquee bulbs
    for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
      g.fillStyle = i % 2 ? "#ffd166" : "#fff3c4";
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(40 + i * 37.5, 28, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.arc(40 + i * 37.5, h - 28, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }
    g.textAlign = "center";
    g.fillStyle = "#ffd166";
    g.font = `600 46px ${FONT}, sans-serif`;
    g.fillText(f.kicker, w / 2, 120);
    g.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    g.font = `600 84px ${FONT}, sans-serif`;
    const words = f.title.split(" ");
    const lines: string[] = [];
    let cur = "";
    for (const wd of words) { if (g.measureText(cur + " " + wd).width > w - 120 && cur) { lines.push(cur); cur = wd; } else cur = cur ? cur + " " + wd : wd; }
    lines.push(cur);
    lines.forEach((l, i) => g.fillText(l, w / 2, 230 + i * 92));
    if (f.left || f.right) {
      const y = 230 + lines.length * 92 + 40;
      g.font = `600 70px ${FONT}, sans-serif`;
      g.fillStyle = "#7fe0ff";
      g.fillText(f.left ?? "", w * 0.25, y);
      g.fillStyle = "#ff8fab";
      g.fillText(f.right ?? "", w * 0.75, y);
      g.fillStyle = "#ffd166";
      g.font = `600 56px ${FONT}, sans-serif`;
      g.fillText("VS", w / 2, y - 4);
    }
  });

/**
 * A scoreboard on two posts that springs up from the ground at `upAt`, swaps to `face2` at `swapAt`
 * (flip), and sinks at `downAt`. Facing +Z at `p` (rotate with `yaw`).
 */
export const PopBoard: React.FC<{ p: V3; yaw?: number; scale?: number; t: number; upAt: number; swapAt: number; downAt: number; face1: BoardFace; face2: BoardFace }> = ({ p, yaw = 0, scale = 1, t, upAt, swapAt, downAt, face1, face2 }) => {
  const up = springUp((t - upAt) / 0.9) * (1 - Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - downAt) / 0.45)) ** 2);
  if (up <= 0.001) return null;
  const flip = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - swapAt) / 0.35));
  const face = flip < 0.5 ? face1 : face2;
  const rot = Math.PI * (flip < 0.5 ? flip : flip - 1);
  const W = 2.2, H = 1.375;
  const sink = (1 - up) * 3.4;
  const post = phys("cfboardpost2", { color: "#2d3340", roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.5 });
  const gold = phys("cftrophy", { color: "#f4c542", metalness: 1, roughness: 0.25 });
  return (
    <group position={[p[0], p[1] - sink * scale, p[2]]} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]} scale={scale}>
      {[-1, 1].map((s) => <mesh key={s} geometry={cyl(0.06, 0.06, 2.6, 12)} material={post} position={[s * 0.85, 1.3, -0.04]} castShadow />)}
      <group position={[0, 2.35, 0]} rotation={[rot, 0, 0]}>
        <mesh geometry={box(W + 0.12, H + 0.12, 0.12, 0.05)} material={phys("cfboardframe", { color: "#f2b544", roughness: 0.4, clearcoat: 0.5 })} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={cached("cfpopboard", () => new PlaneGeometry(W, H))} material={phys(`cfpopface${face.title}${face.left}`, { map: boardTex(face), emissive: "#ffffff", emissiveMap: boardTex(face), emissiveIntensity: 0.35, roughness: 0.4 })} position={[0, 0, 0.065]} />
      </group>
      {/* trophy on top */}
      <group position={[0, 3.2 + 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 3), 0]} rotation={[0, t * 1.2, 0]}>
        <mesh geometry={lathe("cftrophycup", [[0, 0], [0.16, 0], [0.16, 0.04], [0.05, 0.08], [0.04, 0.2], [0.1, 0.26], [0.19, 0.42], [0.21, 0.52], [0.0, 0.52]], 32)} material={gold} castShadow />
        {[-1, 1].map((s) => <mesh key={s} geometry={torus(0.07, 0.016, 8, 20)} material={gold} position={[s * 0.22, 0.4, 0]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} />)}
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

/** Tumbleweed rolling from `a` to `b` between t0 and t1, bouncing. */
export const Tumbleweed: React.FC<{ a: V3; b: V3; t: number; t0: number; t1: number; r?: number }> = ({ a, b, t, t0, t1, r = 0.32 }) => {
  if (t < t0 || t > t1) return null;
  const k = (t - t0) / (t1 - t0);
  const x = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k, z = a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * k;
  const dist = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[2] - a[2]) * k;
  const bounce = Math.abs(Math.sin(k * Math.PI * 5)) * 0.25 * (1 - 0.5 * k);
  const roll = dist / r;
  const dir = Math.atan2(b[0] - a[0], b[2] - a[2]);
  const twig = phys("cftwig", { color: "#b08a55", roughness: 0.85 });
  return (
    <group position={[x, a[1] + r + bounce, z]} rotation={[0, dir, 0]}>
      <group rotation={[roll, 0, 0]}>
        {Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, i) => (
          <mesh key={i} geometry={torus(r * (0.6 + 0.4 * hash1(i, 3)), 0.012, 4, 24)} material={twig} rotation={[hash1(i, 5) * 6.3, hash1(i, 7) * 6.3, hash1(i, 9) * 6.3]} castShadow />
        ))}
        <mesh geometry={sphere(r * 0.35, 8, 6)} material={twig} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

==== 6232 src/kits/characterflow/fx/icons.ts
// Flat glyph textures for thought bubbles and the swarm (drawn, not emoji — every machine renders them
// the same). White glyph on transparent; bubbles tint them.

import { canvasTex } from "../lib/mats.ts";
import { FONT } from "../../../core/type/fonts.ts";

export type IconName = "question" | "exclaim" | "cross" | "clock" | "chat" | "cloud" | "heart" | "chart" | "bell" | "dots";

export const ICONS: IconName[] = ["question", "exclaim", "cross", "clock", "chat", "cloud", "heart", "chart"];

export const iconTex = (name: IconName) =>
  canvasTex(`cficon${name}`, 256, 256, (g, w, h) => {
    g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    g.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    g.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
    g.lineCap = "round";
    g.lineJoin = "round";
    const cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2;
    if (name === "question" || name === "exclaim") {
      g.font = `600 170px ${FONT}, sans-serif`;
      g.textAlign = "center";
      g.textBaseline = "middle";
      g.fillText(name === "question" ? "?" : "!", cx, cy + 8);
    } else if (name === "cross") {
      g.lineWidth = 30;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(cx - 55, cy - 55); g.lineTo(cx + 55, cy + 55);
      g.moveTo(cx + 55, cy - 55); g.lineTo(cx - 55, cy + 55);
      g.stroke();
    } else if (name === "clock" || name === "bell") {
      if (name === "bell") {
        g.beginPath();
        g.moveTo(cx - 70, cy + 45);
        g.quadraticCurveTo(cx - 60, cy - 85, cx, cy - 85);
        g.quadraticCurveTo(cx + 60, cy - 85, cx + 70, cy + 45);
        g.closePath();
        g.fill();
        g.fillRect(cx - 85, cy + 40, 170, 20);
        g.beginPath();
        g.arc(cx, cy + 75, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
        g.lineWidth = 12;
        for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
          g.beginPath();
          g.arc(cx, cy - 10, 105, s > 0 ? -0.5 : Math.PI - 0.3, s > 0 ? 0.3 : Math.PI + 0.5);
          g.stroke();
        }
      } else {
        g.lineWidth = 18;
        g.beginPath();
        g.arc(cx, cy, 80, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.stroke();
        g.lineWidth = 16;
        g.beginPath();
        g.moveTo(cx, cy); g.lineTo(cx, cy - 50);
        g.moveTo(cx, cy); g.lineTo(cx + 38, cy + 14);
        g.stroke();
      }
    } else if (name === "chat" || name === "dots") {
      g.beginPath();
      g.roundRect(cx - 95, cy - 70, 190, 120, 40);
      g.fill();
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(cx - 40, cy + 40); g.lineTo(cx - 70, cy + 90); g.lineTo(cx - 5, cy + 48);
      g.fill();
      g.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
      for (const dx of [-45, 0, 45]) {
        g.beginPath();
        g.arc(cx + dx, cy - 10, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }
      g.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
    } else if (name === "cloud") {
      for (const [dx, dy, r] of [[-45, 10, 45], [10, -20, 60], [60, 15, 40], [0, 25, 45]]) {
        g.beginPath();
        g.arc(cx + dx, cy + dy - 20, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }
      g.lineWidth = 10;
      for (const dx of [-40, 0, 40]) {
        g.beginPath();
        g.moveTo(cx + dx, cy + 55); g.lineTo(cx + dx - 12, cy + 95);
        g.stroke();
      }
    } else if (name === "heart") {
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(cx, cy + 80);
      g.bezierCurveTo(cx - 140, cy - 10, cx - 60, cy - 110, cx, cy - 40);
      g.bezierCurveTo(cx + 60, cy - 110, cx + 140, cy - 10, cx, cy + 80);
      g.fill();
      g.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
      g.lineWidth = 12;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(cx - 5, cy - 40); g.lineTo(cx + 15, cy); g.lineTo(cx - 12, cy + 25); g.lineTo(cx + 6, cy + 70);
      g.stroke();
      g.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
    } else if (name === "chart") {
      g.lineWidth = 18;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(cx - 90, cy - 60); g.lineTo(cx - 30, cy - 10); g.lineTo(cx + 5, cy - 35); g.lineTo(cx + 80, cy + 55);
      g.stroke();
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(cx + 85, cy + 60); g.lineTo(cx + 35, cy + 60); g.lineTo(cx + 85, cy + 10);
      g.closePath();
      g.fill();
    }
  });

/** Soft round bubble backdrop: bright core, rim highlight, transparent outside. */
export const bubbleTex = () =>
  canvasTex("cfbubble", 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {
    const cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2, r = w * 0.47;
    const gr = g.createRadialGradient(cx, cy - r * 0.2, r * 0.1, cx, cy, r);
    gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.96)");
    gr.addColorStop(0.75, "rgba(255,255,255,0.88)");
    gr.addColorStop(0.93, "rgba(255,255,255,0.96)");
    gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
  });

/** Outer glow halo. */
export const haloTex = () =>
  canvasTex("cfhalo", 256, 256, (g, w, h) => {
    const gr = g.createRadialGradient(w / 2, h / 2, 0, w / 2, h / 2, w / 2);
    gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)");
    gr.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(255,255,255,0.22)");
    gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  });

/** Small label texture (speech bubble text, phone UI, screen text). */
export const labelTex = (key: string, w: number, h: number, draw: (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, w: number, h: number) => void) => canvasTex(`cflabel${key}`, w, h, draw);

/** Text for a thought bubble: up to ~4 short lines, auto-wrapped and sized to fit the circle. */
export const textTex = (text: string) =>
  canvasTex(`cftext${text}`, 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {
    g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    g.fillStyle = "#0d1430";
    g.textAlign = "center";
    g.textBaseline = "middle";
    const words = text.split(/\s+/);
    let size = 92;
    let lines: string[] = [];
    for (; size >= 40; size -= 6) {
      g.font = `600 ${size}px ${FONT}, sans-serif`;
      lines = [];
      let cur = "";
      for (const wd of words) {
        const next = cur ? `${cur} ${wd}` : wd;
        if (g.measureText(next).width > w * 0.72 && cur) { lines.push(cur); cur = wd; } else cur = next;
      }
      lines.push(cur);
      if (lines.length * size * 1.12 < h * 0.62 && lines.every((l) => g.measureText(l).width < w * 0.78)) break;
    }
    const lh = size * 1.12, y0 = h / 2 - ((lines.length - 1) * lh) / 2;
    lines.forEach((l, i) => g.fillText(l, w / 2, y0 + i * lh));
  });

==== 14998 src/kits/characterflow/fx/Thoughts.tsx
// Thought field: imagined situations orbiting a character's head. Bubbles are data (ThoughtDef), the
// field's behaviour over time is a FieldMood that the scene computes (drift → swirl, calm → ghost →
// alarm, freeze, dissolve). Large bubbles hold staged mini scenes (vignettes.tsx) or a glyph; the swarm
// is instanced (cheap at 100+). Everything glowing sits on FX_LAYER so depth passes ignore it.
//
// Placement frame: `back` is the direction from the camera side toward the set (bubbles start behind
// and beside the head); when the swirl carries a bubble round to the camera side it is pushed up/down
// and outward so it never covers the face.

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import {
  AdditiveBlending,
  Color,
  DoubleSide,
  InstancedMesh,
  Matrix4,
  MeshBasicMaterial,
  PlaneGeometry,
  Quaternion,
  SphereGeometry,
  Vector3,
} from "three";
import { FX_LAYER } from "../../../core/render/Post.tsx";
import { setMiniFade } from "../character/materials.ts";
import { BIMA, BOSS, FRIEND, NAYA, RAKA, RAKA_OUT, type V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";
import { cached, sphere, torus } from "../lib/geo.ts";
import { hash1, mixHex } from "../lib/mats.ts";
import { bubbleTex, haloTex, iconTex, ICONS, textTex, type IconName } from "./icons.ts";
import { Vignette, type Cast, type VignetteName, type VignetteText } from "./vignettes.tsx";

export type ThoughtDef = {
  id: string;
  at: number;
  vignette?: VignetteName;
  icon?: IconName;
  /** offset from the field centre in the field frame: [right, up, back] metres (right/back are
   *  horizontal and follow `back`, the direction away from the main camera) */
  slot: [number, number, number];
  size: number;
  trail?: boolean;
  /** scale with the alarm pulse */
  pulses?: boolean;
  /** this bubble only exists from `at` until `until` */
  until?: number;
  /** who plays in the vignette */
  cast?: Cast;
  /** short text written inside the bubble (any topic, no vignette needed) */
  text?: string;
};

export type FieldMood = {
  /** accumulated orbit angle (rad) — the scene integrates its own speed */
  phase: number;
  /** motion clock (stops at a freeze) */
  tm: number;
  agitation: number;
  ghost: number;
  alarm: number;
  pulse: number;
  dissolve: number;
  tight: number;
  /** overall visibility of the large bubbles */
  show: number;
};

export type SwarmDef = { at: number; spread: number; count: number; rMin: number; rMax: number };

const COOL = { disc: "#f3f9ff", rim: "#8fdcff", glow: "#7fd0ff", ink: "#2f5d8a" };
const HOT = { disc: "#ffd9d2", rim: "#ff4a3d", glow: "#ff3d2e", ink: "#b3201b" };
const GHOST = { disc: "#c9d3e0", rim: "#b8c6d8", glow: "#8aa0c0", ink: "#7a8aa3" };

const colors = (m: FieldMood) => {
  const pick = (k: keyof typeof COOL) => mixHex(mixHex(COOL[k], GHOST[k], m.ghost), HOT[k], m.alarm);
  return { disc: pick("disc"), rim: pick("rim"), glow: pick("glow"), ink: pick("ink") };
};

const popIn = (x: number) => {
  if (x <= 0) return 0;
  if (x >= 1) return 1;
  const c1 = 1.9, c3 = c1 + 1;
  return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(x - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(x - 1, 2);
};

const billboard = (pos: V3, cam: V3) =>
  new Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(new Matrix4().lookAt(new Vector3(...cam), new Vector3(...pos), new Vector3(0, 1, 0)));

/** World position of a slot at time t. The (right, back) part orbits round the vertical axis with the
 *  field phase; while it passes the camera side it is pushed up/down and outward, clear of the face. */
export const slotPos = (slot: [number, number, number], center: V3, back: V3, m: FieldMood, seed: number): V3 => {
  const [x0, y0, d0] = slot;
  const b = new Vector3(...back).setY(0).normalize();
  const rt = new Vector3(-b.z, 0, b.x);
  const ang = Math.atan2(x0, d0) + m.phase * (0.8 + 0.4 * hash1(seed, 3)) + 0.1 * Math.sin(m.tm * 0.6 + seed);
  const rad = Math.hypot(x0, d0) * m.tight;
  const front = Math.max(0, -Math.cos(ang));
  const y = y0 + Math.sign(y0 - 0.05 || 1) * 0.45 * front + 0.035 * Math.sin(m.tm * (1.1 + m.agitation * 3) + seed * 1.7) * (1 + 2 * m.agitation);
  const r = rad * (1 + 0.5 * front) + 0.015 * Math.sin(m.tm * 2.3 + seed);
  const d = b.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(ang) * r).addScaledVector(rt, Math.sin(ang) * r);
  return [center[0] + d.x, center[1] + y, center[2] + d.z];
};

/** 0 when a bubble would sit on the lens, 1 from a comfortable distance. */
const nearFade = (p: V3 | Vector3, cam: V3) => {
  const v = p instanceof Vector3 ? p : new Vector3(...p);
  const dd = v.distanceTo(new Vector3(...cam));
  const k = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (dd - 0.45) / 0.5));
  return k * k * (3 - 2 * k);
};

const glowMat = () => new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: haloTex(), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false });
const mats = new Map<string, MeshBasicMaterial>();
const M = (key: string, make: () => MeshBasicMaterial) => {
  let m = mats.get(key);
  if (!m) { m = make(); mats.set(key, m); }
  return m;
};
const unit = () => cached("cfunitplane", () => new PlaneGeometry(1, 1));

const Bubble: React.FC<{ d: ThoughtDef; i: number; t: number; pos: V3; cam: V3; head: V3; mood: FieldMood; txt: VignetteText; C: ReturnType<typeof colors> }> = ({ d, i, t, pos, cam, head, mood, txt, C }) => {
  const age = t - d.at;
  const out = d.until !== undefined ? 1 - Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - d.until) / 0.3)) : 1;
  let s = d.size * popIn(age / 0.45) * out * mood.show * (1 - 0.85 * mood.dissolve);
  if (d.pulses) s *= 1 + 0.12 * mood.pulse;
  s *= nearFade(pos, cam);
  if (s <= 0.002) return null;
  const q = billboard(pos, cam);
  const flick = mood.ghost > 0 ? 1 - mood.ghost * (0.28 + 0.22 * Math.sin(t * 23 + i * 2.1)) : 1;
  const disc = M(`disc${i}`, () => new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: bubbleTex(), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: DoubleSide }));
  disc.color.set(C.disc);
  disc.opacity = 0.97 * flick * (1 - mood.dissolve);
  const halo = M(`halo${i}`, glowMat);
  halo.color.set(C.glow);
  halo.opacity = (0.3 + 0.25 * mood.alarm * mood.pulse) * (1 - mood.dissolve);
  const rim = M(`rim${i}`, () => new MeshBasicMaterial({ toneMapped: false }));
  rim.color.set(C.rim).multiplyScalar(1.3 + 0.8 * mood.alarm * mood.pulse);
  const ink = M(`ink${i}`, () => new MeshBasicMaterial({ transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: DoubleSide }));
  if (d.icon) ink.map = iconTex(d.icon);
  ink.color.set(C.ink);
  ink.opacity = flick * (1 - mood.dissolve);
  const dashes = 28, dashK = 1 - 0.55 * mood.ghost;
  const trail = d.trail ? [0.3, 0.5, 0.68].map((f) => [head[0] + (pos[0] - head[0]) * f, head[1] + 0.12 + (pos[1] - head[1] - 0.12) * f, head[2] + (pos[2] - head[2]) * f] as V3) : [];
  return (
    <>
      <group position={pos} quaternion={q} scale={s}>
        <mesh geometry={unit()} material={halo} scale={3.2} position={[0, 0, -0.05]} layers={FX_LAYER} />
        <mesh geometry={cached("cfbubbledisc", () => new PlaneGeometry(2.04, 2.04))} material={disc} layers={FX_LAYER} />
        {Array.from({ length: dashes }, (_, k) => (
          <mesh key={k} geometry={torus(1.0, 0.03, 6, 6, ((Math.PI * 2) / dashes) * dashK)} material={rim} rotation={[0, 0, (k / dashes) * Math.PI * 2 + mood.tm * 0.4]} layers={FX_LAYER} />
        ))}
        {d.icon ? <mesh geometry={unit()} material={ink} scale={1.25} position={[0, 0, 0.02]} layers={FX_LAYER} /> : null}
        {d.text ? <mesh geometry={unit()} material={M(`txt${d.text}`, () => new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: textTex(d.text!), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, toneMapped: false }))} scale={1.7} position={[0, 0, 0.025]} layers={FX_LAYER} /> : null}
        {d.vignette ? (
          <group position={[0, -0.8, 0.08]} scale={0.6}>
            <Vignette name={d.vignette} t={t + i * 1.3} txt={txt} cast={d.cast} />
          </group>
        ) : null}
      </group>
      {trail.map((p, k) => (
        <mesh key={`tr${k}`} geometry={sphere(1, 16, 12)} material={disc} position={p} scale={s * (0.08 + 0.07 * k)} layers={FX_LAYER} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
};

// ── swarm (instanced) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
type Inst = { dir: Vector3; r: number; at: number; icon: number; size: number; seed: number };
const swarmData = (S: SwarmDef, back: V3): Inst[] => {
  const out: Inst[] = [];
  const b = new Vector3(...back).normalize();
  const golden = Math.PI * (3 - Math.sqrt(5));
  for (let i = 0, k = 0; out.length < S.count && k < S.count * 4; k++) {
    const y = 1 - (k / (S.count * 4 - 1)) * 2;
    const rr = Math.sqrt(1 - y * y);
    const dir = new Vector3(Math.cos(golden * k) * rr * 0.62, y * 1.1 + 0.2, Math.sin(golden * k) * rr * 0.62);
    // keep the camera side clear (nothing between the lens and the face)
    if (new Vector3(dir.x, 0, dir.z).normalize().dot(b) < -0.15 && dir.y < 1.1) continue;
    if (hash1(k, 41) < 0.5) continue;
    out.push({ dir, r: S.rMin + (S.rMax - S.rMin) * hash1(k, 5), at: S.at + S.spread * hash1(i, 9), icon: i % ICONS.length, size: 0.05 + 0.05 * hash1(k, 13), seed: k });
    i++;
  }
  return out;
};

const Swarm: React.FC<{ S: SwarmDef; t: number; center: V3; back: V3; cam: V3; mood: FieldMood; C: ReturnType<typeof colors> }> = ({ S, t, center, back, cam, mood, C }) => {
  const data = useMemo(() => swarmData(S, back), [S, back]);
  const meshes = useMemo(() => {
    const discs = new InstancedMesh(cached("cfswarmdisc", () => new PlaneGeometry(2.04, 2.04)), new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: bubbleTex(), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: DoubleSide }), data.length);
    const icons = ICONS.map((name, k) => new InstancedMesh(unit(), new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: iconTex(name), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: DoubleSide }), data.filter((d) => d.icon === k).length));
    const glow = new InstancedMesh(unit(), new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: haloTex(), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false }), data.length);
    for (const m of [discs, glow, ...icons]) { m.frustumCulled = false; m.layers.set(FX_LAYER); }
    return { discs, icons, glow };
  }, [data]);
  const q = billboard(center, cam);
  const counters = ICONS.map(() => 0);
  const mx = new Matrix4(), mg = new Matrix4();
  data.forEach((d, i) => {
    const age = t - d.at;
    const k = popIn(age / 0.5);
    const sp = mood.phase * (0.6 + 0.5 * hash1(d.seed, 2));
    const dir = d.dir.clone().applyAxisAngle(new Vector3(0, 1, 0), sp);
    // swirled round to the camera side: lift away from the face, push out and shrink
    const hb = new Vector3(dir.x, 0, dir.z).normalize().dot(new Vector3(...back).setY(0).normalize());
    const front = Math.max(0, -hb);
    dir.y += 0.7 * front * Math.sign(dir.y + 0.05);
    const r = d.r * mood.tight * (1 + 0.5 * front) * (0.35 + 0.65 * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, age / 0.6)));
    const bob = 0.03 * Math.sin(mood.tm * (1.3 + 2.5 * mood.agitation) + d.seed) * (1 + 2 * mood.agitation);
    const up = mood.dissolve * (0.25 + 0.5 * hash1(d.seed, 17));
    const p = new Vector3(center[0] + dir.x * r, center[1] + dir.y * r + bob + up, center[2] + dir.z * r);
    const s = d.size * k * (1 - mood.dissolve) * mood.show * (1 + 0.15 * mood.pulse * mood.alarm) * nearFade(p, cam) * (1 - 0.6 * front);
    mx.compose(p, q, new Vector3(s, s, s));
    mg.compose(p.clone().addScaledVector(new Vector3(...back).normalize(), 0.01), q, new Vector3(s * 3, s * 3, s * 3));
    meshes.discs.setMatrixAt(i, mx);
    meshes.glow.setMatrixAt(i, mg);
    const ic = meshes.icons[d.icon];
    const p2 = p.clone().addScaledVector(new Vector3(...cam).sub(p).normalize(), 0.004);
    mx.compose(p2, q, new Vector3(s * 1.2, s * 1.2, s * 1.2));
    ic.setMatrixAt(counters[d.icon]++, mx);
  });
  for (const m of [meshes.discs, meshes.glow, ...meshes.icons]) m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  const flick = 1 - mood.ghost * 0.35;
  (meshes.discs.material as MeshBasicMaterial).color.set(C.disc);
  (meshes.discs.material as MeshBasicMaterial).opacity = 0.9 * flick;
  (meshes.glow.material as MeshBasicMaterial).color.set(C.glow);
  (meshes.glow.material as MeshBasicMaterial).opacity = 0.22 + 0.2 * mood.alarm * mood.pulse;
  for (const ic of meshes.icons) {
    (ic.material as MeshBasicMaterial).color.set(C.ink);
    (ic.material as MeshBasicMaterial).opacity = flick;
  }
  return (
    <>
      <primitive object={meshes.glow} />
      <primitive object={meshes.discs} />
      {meshes.icons.map((m, k) => <primitive key={k} object={m} />)}
    </>
  );
};

// ── motes: what the thoughts dissolve into ──────────────────────────────────
const Motes: React.FC<{ t: number; from: V3[]; t0: number; cam: V3 }> = ({ t, from, t0, cam }) => {
  const N = 140;
  const mesh = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new InstancedMesh(cached("cfmote", () => new SphereGeometry(1, 8, 6)), new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: new Color("#ffe3a8"), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false }), N);
    m.frustumCulled = false;
    m.layers.set(FX_LAYER);
    return m;
  }, []);
  const age = t - t0;
  const mx = new Matrix4();
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const src = from[i % Math.max(1, from.length)] ?? [0, 0, 0];
    const life = 2.2 + 1.6 * hash1(i, 3);
    const a = Math.max(0, age - 0.25 * hash1(i, 7));
    const k = Math.min(1, a / life);
    const p = new Vector3(src[0] + (hash1(i, 11) - 0.5) * 0.3 + 0.1 * Math.sin(a * 1.3 + i), src[1] + (hash1(i, 13) - 0.5) * 0.3 + a * (0.12 + 0.12 * hash1(i, 19)), src[2] + (hash1(i, 23) - 0.5) * 0.3 + 0.1 * Math.cos(a * 1.1 + i));
    const s = age <= 0 ? 0 : 0.006 * (1 + hash1(i, 29)) * Math.sin(Math.PI * k);
    mx.compose(p, new Quaternion(), new Vector3(s, s, s));
    mesh.setMatrixAt(i, mx);
  }
  mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  void cam;
  return <primitive object={mesh} />;
};

export const ThoughtField: React.FC<{
  defs: ThoughtDef[];
  swarm?: SwarmDef;
  t: number;
  center: V3;
  head: V3;
  back: V3;
  cam: V3;
  mood: FieldMood;
  txt: Record<string, VignetteText>;
  motesAt?: number;
}> = ({ defs, swarm, t, center, head, back, cam, mood, txt, motesAt }) => {
  const C = colors(mood);
  const miniFade = (1 - 0.5 * mood.ghost) * (1 - mood.dissolve);
  for (const s of [RAKA, RAKA_OUT, BIMA, FRIEND, BOSS, NAYA]) setMiniFade(s, miniFade);
  const live = defs.filter((d) => t >= d.at);
  const positions = live.map((d, i) => slotPos(d.slot, center, back, mood, i + 1));
  return (
    <group>
      {live.map((d, i) => (
        <Bubble key={d.id} d={d} i={i} t={t} pos={positions[i]} cam={cam} head={head} mood={mood} txt={txt[d.id] ?? {}} C={C} />
      ))}
      {swarm && t >= swarm.at ? <Swarm S={swarm} t={t} center={center} back={back} cam={cam} mood={mood} C={C} /> : null}
      {motesAt !== undefined && t >= motesAt ? <Motes t={t} from={positions} t0={motesAt} cam={cam} /> : null}
    </group>
  );
};

==== 12667 src/kits/characterflow/fx/vignettes.tsx
// Imagined situations: tiny staged scenes that live inside thought bubbles. They are cast from the
// SAME character system (spec + presets + performance) in the "mini" material variant, so the lead is
// recognisable inside his own thoughts. Each vignette is built in a 1-unit stage (feet at y = 0,
// facing the viewer at +Z) and scaled into the bubble by Thoughts.tsx.
// Text on screens/phones comes from the topic (props), so the vignettes are reusable.

import React from "react";
import { PlaneGeometry } from "three";
import { Character } from "../character/Character.tsx";
import { perform, type Beat, type Performance } from "../character/performance.ts";
import { BIMA, BOSS, FRIEND, NAYA, RAKA, RAKA_OUT, type CharacterSpec } from "../character/spec.ts";
import { box, cached, cyl, sphere } from "../lib/geo.ts";
import { basic, phys } from "../lib/mats.ts";
import { FONT } from "../../../core/type/fonts.ts";
import { labelTex } from "./icons.ts";

const perfs = new Map<string, Performance>();
const perf = (key: string, spec: CharacterSpec, x: number, z: number, yaw: number, beats: Omit<Beat, "at">[]): Performance => {
  let p = perfs.get(key);
  if (!p) {
    p = { spec, anchor: { x, y: 0, z, yaw }, beats: beats.map((b, i) => ({ at: i * 0.9, dur: 0.4, ...b })) };
    perfs.set(key, p);
  }
  return p;
};

const Mini: React.FC<{ p: Performance; t: number; seed: number }> = ({ p, t, seed }) => {
  const { pose } = perform(p, t, seed);
  return <Character pose={pose} spec={p.spec} t={t} variant="mini" shadows={false} />;
};

const plane = (w: number, h: number) => cached(`cfvplane${w},${h}`, () => new PlaneGeometry(w, h));

export type VignetteText = { speech?: string; screen?: string; phoneName?: string; phoneMsg?: string; phoneStatus?: string; clock?: string };
export type VignetteName = "talk" | "fail" | "late" | "seen" | "boss" | "laugh" | "friends" | "forgot" | "weird";
/** `a` = the thinker (default Raka), `b` = the other person (default a friend) */
export type Cast = { a?: CharacterSpec; b?: CharacterSpec };
type VP = { t: number; txt: VignetteText; cast?: Cast };

const Talk: React.FC<VP> = ({ t, txt }) => {
  const a = perf("talk-r", RAKA, -0.42, 0, 0.55, [{ body: "stand", armL: "explain", armR: "rest", face: "talk", look: [0.5, 1.5, 0] }]);
  const b = perf("talk-f", FRIEND, 0.42, 0, -0.55, [{ body: "stand", arms: "crossArms", face: "angry", look: [-0.5, 1.5, 0] }]);
  const sp = labelTex(`speech${txt.speech}`, 256, 160, (g, w, h) => {
    g.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    g.beginPath();
    g.roundRect(8, 8, w - 16, h - 50, 36);
    g.fill();
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(60, h - 46); g.lineTo(40, h - 6); g.lineTo(100, h - 46);
    g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = "#e4572e";
    g.font = `600 70px ${FONT}, sans-serif`;
    g.textAlign = "center";
    g.textBaseline = "middle";
    g.fillText(txt.speech ?? "!?", w / 2, (h - 40) / 2 + 6);
  });
  return (
    <group>
      <Mini p={a} t={t} seed={3} />
      <Mini p={b} t={t + 0.7} seed={4} />
      <mesh geometry={plane(0.55, 0.34)} material={basic(`cfspeech${txt.speech}`, { map: sp, transparent: true })} position={[-0.42, 2.05, 0.3]} />
    </group>
  );
};

const Fail: React.FC<VP> = ({ t, txt }) => {

  const scr = labelTex(`screen${txt.screen}`, 512, 320, (g, w, h) => {
    g.fillStyle = "#f6f7fb";
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    g.strokeStyle = "#d9dde6";
    g.lineWidth = 3;
    for (let y = 70; y < h; y += 50) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(30, y); g.lineTo(w - 30, y); g.stroke(); }
    g.strokeStyle = "#e5383b";
    g.lineWidth = 16;
    g.lineCap = "round";
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(40, 80); g.lineTo(160, 130); g.lineTo(240, 110); g.lineTo(380, 250); g.lineTo(470, 280);
    g.stroke();
    g.fillStyle = "#1f2430";
    g.font = `600 46px ${FONT}, sans-serif`;
    g.fillText(txt.screen ?? "", 34, 50);
  });
  return (

      <Mini p={a} t={t} seed={5} />
    </group>
  );
};

const Late: React.FC<VP> = ({ t, txt }) => {

  const face = labelTex(`clock${txt.clock}`, 256, 256, (g, w, h) => {
    g.fillStyle = "#fffaf0";
    g.beginPath();

    g.fill();

    g.font = `600 64px ${FONT}, sans-serif`;
    g.textAlign = "center";
    g.textBaseline = "middle";
    g.fillText(txt.clock ?? "08:47", w / 2, h / 2 + 4);
  });

        ))}

/** "Does he still remember me?" — he waves, the other one draws a blank. */
