/** "Would it be weird if I said hi first?" — a huge wave, a baffled stare. */
const Weird: React.FC<VP> = ({ t, cast }) => {
  const A = cast?.a ?? BIMA, B = cast?.b ?? RAKA_OUT;
  const wave = (tt: number) => ({ arm: { sw: 0.35, ab: 1.05 + 0.22 * Math.sin(tt * 12), tw: 0.4, el: 1.5 + 0.2 * Math.sin(tt * 12 + 1), wr: [0, 0, 0] as [number, number, number] }, hand: { curl: 0.05, index: 0.03, thumb: 0.1, spread: 0.6 } });
  const a = perf(`weird-a${A.id}`, A, -0.42, 0.1, 0.6, [{ body: "standProud", armL: "rest", armR: wave, face: "laughing", look: [0.5, 1.5, 0] }]);
  const b = perf(`weird-b${B.id}`, B, 0.45, 0, -0.6, [{ body: "standCower", armL: "rest", armR: "rest", face: { base: "startled", add: { smile: -0.4 } }, look: [-0.5, 1.6, 0] }]);
  return (
    <group>
      <Mini p={a} t={t} seed={17} />
      <Mini p={b} t={t + 0.3} seed={18} />
      <Speech text="…?" color="#e4572e" at={[0.55, 2.0, 0.3]} />
    </group>
  );
};

export const VIGNETTES: Record<VignetteName, React.FC<VP>> = { talk: Talk, fail: Fail, late: Late, seen: Seen, boss: Boss, laugh: Laugh, friends: Friends, forgot: Forgot, weird: Weird };

export const Vignette: React.FC<{ name: VignetteName; t: number; txt: VignetteText; cast?: Cast }> = ({ name, t, txt, cast }) => {
  const V = VIGNETTES[name];
  return <V t={t} txt={txt} cast={cast} />;
};


==== 4099 src/kits/characterflow/lib/geo.ts
// Small geometry kit for architecture: struts between points, merged lattices, lathe and
// arch profiles, geodesic frames. Geometries are cached by key so a film builds each once.

import {
  BufferGeometry,
  CylinderGeometry,
  IcosahedronGeometry,
  LatheGeometry,
  Matrix4,
  Quaternion,
  Shape,
  SphereGeometry,
  TorusGeometry,
  Vector2,
  Vector3,
} from "three";
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from "three/examples/jsm/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js";
import { mergeGeometries } from "three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js";

const cache = new Map<string, BufferGeometry>();
export const cached = <G extends BufferGeometry>(key: string, make: () => G): G => {
  let g = cache.get(key);
  if (!g) {
    g = make();
    cache.set(key, g);
  }
  return g as G;
};

export const cyl = (rt: number, rb: number, h: number, seg = 32, open = false, ts = 0, tl = Math.PI * 2) =>
  cached(`cyl${rt},${rb},${h},${seg},${open},${ts},${tl}`, () => new CylinderGeometry(rt, rb, h, seg, 1, open, ts, tl));
export const box = (w: number, h: number, d: number, r = 0.04, seg = 2) =>
  cached(`box${w},${h},${d},${r}`, () => new RoundedBoxGeometry(w, h, d, seg, Math.min(r, w / 2.01, h / 2.01, d / 2.01)));
export const sphere = (r: number, ws = 32, hs = 16, phiLen = Math.PI * 2, thetaLen = Math.PI) =>
  cached(`sph${r},${ws},${hs},${phiLen},${thetaLen}`, () => new SphereGeometry(r, ws, hs, 0, phiLen, 0, thetaLen));
export const torus = (R: number, r: number, rs = 8, ts = 48, arc = Math.PI * 2) =>
  cached(`tor${R},${r},${rs},${ts},${arc}`, () => new TorusGeometry(R, r, rs, ts, arc));
export const lathe = (key: string, pts: [number, number][], seg = 64) =>
  cached(`lathe${key}`, () => new LatheGeometry(pts.map(([x, y]) => new Vector2(x, y)), seg));

const UP = new Vector3(0, 1, 0);
/** A cylinder from p to q (world-free; positions in the caller's frame). */
export const strutGeo = (p: Vector3, q: Vector3, r: number, seg = 6) => {
  const d = new Vector3().subVectors(q, p);
  const len = d.length();
  const g = new CylinderGeometry(r, r, len, seg, 1, false);
  const m = new Matrix4().compose(
    new Vector3().addVectors(p, q).multiplyScalar(0.5),
    new Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(UP, d.normalize()),
    new Vector3(1, 1, 1),
  );
  g.applyMatrix4(m);
  return g;
};

export const merged = (key: string, make: () => BufferGeometry[]) =>
  cached(key, () => {
    const parts = make().map((g) => (g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g));
    for (const p of parts) {
      for (const name of Object.keys(p.attributes)) if (name !== "position" && name !== "normal" && name !== "uv") p.deleteAttribute(name);
    }
    return mergeGeometries(parts, false)!;
  });

/** Geodesic frame over the upper hemisphere (edges of a subdivided icosahedron). */
export const geodesicFrame = (R: number, detail: number, strutR: number) =>
  merged(`geo${R},${detail},${strutR}`, () => {
    const ico = new IcosahedronGeometry(R, detail);
    const p = ico.attributes.position;
    const key = (v: Vector3) => `${v.x.toFixed(3)},${v.y.toFixed(3)},${v.z.toFixed(3)}`;
    const edges = new Map<string, [Vector3, Vector3]>();
    for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i += 3) {
      const tri = [0, 1, 2].map((k) => new Vector3(p.getX(i + k), p.getY(i + k), p.getZ(i + k)));
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        const a = tri[k], b = tri[(k + 1) % 3];
        if (a.y < -0.01 || b.y < -0.01) continue;
        const ka = key(a), kb = key(b);
        const id = ka < kb ? ka + "|" + kb : kb + "|" + ka;
        if (!edges.has(id)) edges.set(id, [a, b]);
      }
    }
    return [...edges.values()].map(([a, b]) => strutGeo(a, b, strutR, 5));
  });

/** Arch outline (flat sides, rounded roof) in the x-y plane, base on y = 0. */
export const archShape = (w: number, h: number, shoulder: number, inset = 0) => {
  const s = new Shape();
  const hw = w / 2 - inset;
  s.moveTo(-hw, inset > 0 ? 0 : 0);
  s.lineTo(-hw, h - shoulder);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(-hw, h - inset, 0, h - inset);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(hw, h - inset, hw, h - shoulder);
  s.lineTo(hw, 0);
  s.lineTo(-hw, 0);
  return s;
};

==== 4182 src/kits/characterflow/lib/mats.ts
// Shared materials, deterministic randomness and procedural canvas textures. Every material is built
// once per key and shared; textures are drawn from seeded randomness, so nothing depends on files.

import {
  CanvasTexture,
  Color,
  type Material,
  MeshBasicMaterial,
  type MeshBasicMaterialParameters,
  MeshPhysicalMaterial,
  type MeshPhysicalMaterialParameters,
  RepeatWrapping,
  SRGBColorSpace,
  type Texture,
} from "three";

export { mulberry32, hash1, noise1 } from "./rng.ts";
import { mulberry32 } from "./rng.ts";

const cache = new Map<string, Material>();
export const phys = (key: string, p: MeshPhysicalMaterialParameters): MeshPhysicalMaterial => {
  let m = cache.get(key) as MeshPhysicalMaterial | undefined;
  if (!m) {
    m = new MeshPhysicalMaterial(p);
    cache.set(key, m);
  }
  return m;
};
export const basic = (key: string, p: MeshBasicMaterialParameters): MeshBasicMaterial => {
  let m = cache.get(key) as MeshBasicMaterial | undefined;
  if (!m) {
    m = new MeshBasicMaterial(p);
    cache.set(key, m);
  }
  return m;
};

const texCache = new Map<string, Texture>();
export const canvasTex = (key: string, w: number, h: number, draw: (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, w: number, h: number) => void, repeat?: [number, number], srgb = true) => {
  let t = texCache.get(key);
  if (!t) {
    const c = document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width = w;
    c.height = h;
    const g = c.getContext("2d")!;
    draw(g, w, h);
    t = new CanvasTexture(c);
    if (srgb) t.colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace;
    t.anisotropy = 8;
    if (repeat) {
      t.wrapS = t.wrapT = RepeatWrapping;
      t.repeat.set(...repeat);
    }
    texCache.set(key, t);
  }
  return t;
};

export const shade = (hex: string, k: number) => {
  const c = new Color(hex);
  c.multiplyScalar(k);
  return `#${c.getHexString()}`;
};
export const mixHex = (a: string, b: string, k: number) => `#${new Color(a).lerp(new Color(b), Math.min(1, Math.max(0, k))).getHexString()}`;

/** Soft woven fabric. */
export const weaveTex = (key: string, color: string, rep: [number, number], stripe?: string) =>
  canvasTex(`weave${key}`, 256, 256, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(3);
    g.fillStyle = color;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 4)
      for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 4) {
        g.fillStyle = `rgba(${(x + y) % 8 ? "255,255,255" : "0,0,0"},${0.02 + r() * 0.03})`;
        g.fillRect(x, y, 4, 2);
      }
    if (stripe) {
      g.fillStyle = stripe;
      for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 64) g.fillRect(0, y + 20, w, 10);
    }
  }, rep);

/** Stylised eye: equirect sphere texture with the iris centred on +Z (u = 0.25, v = 0.5). */
export const eyeTex = (key: string, iris: string) =>
  canvasTex(`eye${key}`, 1024, 512, (g, w, h) => {
    g.fillStyle = "#f7f3ee";
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    // faint warm vignette toward the back of the eyeball
    const bg = g.createRadialGradient(w * 0.25, h * 0.5, w * 0.05, w * 0.25, h * 0.5, w * 0.3);
    bg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    bg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(150,90,80,0.18)");
    g.fillStyle = bg;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const cx = w * 0.25, cy = h * 0.5;
    const rx = w * 0.108, ry = h * 0.216;
    const gr = g.createRadialGradient(cx, cy - ry * 0.25, 0, cx, cy, rx);
    gr.addColorStop(0, shade(iris, 2.1));
    gr.addColorStop(0.5, shade(iris, 1.25));
    gr.addColorStop(0.85, iris);
    gr.addColorStop(1, shade(iris, 0.35));
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,225,170,0.22)";
    g.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let k = 0; k < 64; k++) {
      const a = (k / 64) * Math.PI * 2;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * rx * 0.5, cy + Math.sin(a) * ry * 0.5);
      g.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * rx * 0.88, cy + Math.sin(a) * ry * 0.88);
      g.stroke();
    }
    g.fillStyle = "#0b0706";
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(cx, cy, rx * 0.44, ry * 0.44, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.strokeStyle = shade(iris, 0.25);
    g.lineWidth = 6;
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(cx, cy, rx * 0.985, ry * 0.985, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.stroke();
  });

==== 811 src/kits/characterflow/lib/rng.ts
// Deterministic randomness (Node-safe).
export const mulberry32 = (seed: number) => {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
};
/** Integer hash → [0, 1). */
export const hash1 = (x: number, seed = 0) => {
  let h = (Math.imul(x | 0, 374761393) + Math.imul(seed | 0, 668265263)) | 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177);
  h ^= h >>> 16;
  return (h >>> 0) / 4294967296;
};
/** Smooth 1-D value noise in [-1, 1]. */
export const noise1 = (x: number, seed = 0) => {
  const i = Math.floor(x), f = x - i;
  const u = f * f * (3 - 2 * f);
  return (hash1(i, seed) * (1 - u) + hash1(i + 1, seed) * u) * 2 - 1;
};

==== 7100 src/kits/characterflow/locomotion/stand.ts
// Standing and sitting blocking with planted feet (leg IK), for any character.
//
//   standBody — standing on a mark: living idle (slow weight shift), turns in place with real steps
//               (each foot lifts and re-plants at the new heading, staggered), optional base preset.
//   seatBody  — a chair/bench/bed-edge seat: sits down and stands up through a forward-lean crouch
//               while the feet stay planted in front of the seat.
// Pure maths — the director and the sound department (footsteps on turns) share it.

import { BODY, type BodyName } from "../character/presets/bodies.ts";
import { blend, clonePose, type Pose } from "../character/pose.ts";
import { DIMS, type CharacterSpec, type V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";

const D = Math.PI / 180;
const smooth = (x: number) => { const k = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x)); return k * k * (3 - 2 * k); };
const ANKLE_H = 0.087;

export type Turn = { at: number; dur: number; to: number };
const wrap = (a: number) => { while (a > Math.PI) a -= 2 * Math.PI; while (a < -Math.PI) a += 2 * Math.PI; return a; };

/** Heading at time t after a list of turns (shortest way round). */
export const yawAt = (yaw0: number, turns: Turn[], t: number, lag = 0) => {
  let y = yaw0;
  for (const tr of turns) {
    if (t < tr.at) break;
    const k = smooth((t - tr.at - lag * tr.dur) / tr.dur);
    y = y + wrap(tr.to - y) * k;
  }
  return y;
};

const quatYXZ = (yaw: number, pitch: number): [number, number, number, number] => {
  const cy = Math.cos(yaw / 2), sy = Math.sin(yaw / 2), cx = Math.cos(pitch / 2), sx = Math.sin(pitch / 2);
  return [cy * sx, sy * cx, -sy * sx, cy * cx];
};

/** Foot (ankle target + orientation) standing at `pos` with heading `yaw`; side −1 = left, +1 = right. */
const footAt = (pos: V3, yaw: number, side: number, spec: CharacterSpec, lift = 0, back = 0.02): { t: V3; q: [number, number, number, number] } => {
  const gap = 0.1 * spec.scale;
  const fx = Math.sin(yaw), fz = Math.cos(yaw);
  const rx = -fz, rz = fx; // his right
  return {
    t: [pos[0] + rx * gap * side - fx * back, pos[1] + ANKLE_H * spec.scale + lift, pos[2] + rz * gap * side - fz * back],
    q: quatYXZ(yaw - side * 0.07, 0),
  };
};

/** Turn progress of one foot inside a turn: left steps first, right follows. */
const stepK = (turns: Turn[], t: number, first: boolean) => {
  for (const tr of turns) {
    const u = (t - tr.at) / tr.dur;
    if (u > 0 && u < 1) {
      const [a, b] = first ? [0.05, 0.55] : [0.45, 0.95];
      const k = smooth((u - a) / (b - a));
      return { k, lift: 0.06 * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (u - a) / (b - a)))) };
    }
  }
  return null;
};

export const standBody = (spec: CharacterSpec, pos: V3, yaw0: number, turns: Turn[] = [], base: BodyName = "stand", mod?: (p: Pose, t: number) => void) => (t: number): Pose => {
  const yaw = yawAt(yaw0, turns, t);
  const p = clonePose(BODY[base]({ x: pos[0], y: pos[1], z: pos[2], yaw }, spec, t));
  // idle: slow weight shift between the feet
  const w = Math.sin(t * 2 * Math.PI * 0.11 + spec.scale * 10);
  p.hips = [p.hips[0], p.hips[1] + 1.2 * D * w, p.hips[2] + 1.8 * D * w];
  p.chest = [p.chest[0], p.chest[1] - 0.8 * D * w, p.chest[2] - 1.0 * D * w];
  p.x += Math.cos(yaw) * 0.012 * w;
  p.z += -Math.sin(yaw) * 0.012 * w;
  p.hipY -= 0.008;
  // turning: dip a little while stepping round
  for (const tr of turns) { const u = (t - tr.at) / tr.dur; if (u > 0 && u < 1) p.hipY -= 0.018 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u); }
  // feet: each re-plants at the new heading on its own step
  const prevYaw = (side: -1 | 1) => {
    const s = stepK(turns, t, side === -1);
    if (!s) return { yaw, lift: 0 };
    // heading this foot has reached
    let y = yaw0;
    for (const tr of turns) { if (t < tr.at) break; if (t > tr.at + tr.dur) y = y + wrap(tr.to - y); else y = y + wrap(tr.to - y) * s.k; }
    return { yaw: y, lift: s.lift };
  };
  const L = prevYaw(-1), R = prevYaw(1);
  const fl = footAt(pos, L.yaw, -1, spec, L.lift), fr = footAt(pos, R.yaw, 1, spec, R.lift);
  p.legL = { ...p.legL, ik: { t: fl.t, q: fl.q, w: 1 } };
  p.legR = { ...p.legR, ik: { t: fr.t, q: fr.q, w: 1 } };
  if (mod) mod(p, t);
  return p;
};

/** Steps of a turn (for footstep sounds). */
export const turnSteps = (turns: Turn[]) => turns.flatMap((tr) => [tr.at + tr.dur * 0.55, tr.at + tr.dur * 0.95]);

// ── sitting ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export type Seat = { pos: V3; yaw: number; height: number; floor?: number };
/** sit = 1 seated, 0 standing in front of the seat; transitions take ~1 s each */
export type SeatChange = { at: number; sit: boolean; dur?: number };

export const sitAmount = (start: boolean, changes: SeatChange[], t: number) => {
  let k = start ? 1 : 0;
  for (const c of changes) {
    if (t < c.at) break;
    const d = c.dur ?? 1.1;
    const target = c.sit ? 1 : 0;
    k = k + (target - k) * smooth((t - c.at) / d);
  }
  return k;
};

/** Position where he stands when he gets up from the seat (feet stay where they were). */
export const seatStandPos = (s: Seat, spec: CharacterSpec): V3 => {
  const f = 0.36 * spec.scale / 0.94;
  return [s.pos[0] + Math.sin(s.yaw) * f, s.floor ?? 0, s.pos[2] + Math.cos(s.yaw) * f];
};

export const seatBody = (spec: CharacterSpec, seat: Seat, startSeated: boolean, changes: SeatChange[], mod?: (p: Pose, t: number) => void) => (t: number): Pose => {
  const k = sitAmount(startSeated, changes, t);
  const floor = seat.floor ?? 0;
  const standPos = seatStandPos(seat, spec);
  const fx = Math.sin(seat.yaw), fz = Math.cos(seat.yaw);
  // standing
  const st = BODY.stand({ x: standPos[0], y: floor, z: standPos[2], yaw: seat.yaw }, spec, t);
  // seated: pelvis on the seat, thighs forward, upright back
  const se = clonePose(BODY.stand({ x: seat.pos[0], y: floor, z: seat.pos[2], yaw: seat.yaw }, spec, t));
  se.y = seat.height + 0.1 * spec.scale - DIMS.pelvisH * spec.scale;
  se.hips = [-4 * D, 0, 0];
  se.spine = [5 * D, 0, 0];
  se.chest = [5 * D, 0, 0];
  se.armL = { ...se.armL, sw: 0.45, ab: 0.14, el: 0.7 };
  se.armR = { ...se.armR, sw: 0.45, ab: 0.14, el: 0.7 };
  // half-way: weight forward over the feet
  const cr = clonePose(st);
  cr.x = (seat.pos[0] + standPos[0]) / 2 + fx * 0.06;
  cr.z = (seat.pos[2] + standPos[2]) / 2 + fz * 0.06;
  cr.y = floor + (seat.height + 0.1 * spec.scale - DIMS.pelvisH * spec.scale - floor) * 0.55;
  cr.hips = [22 * D, 0, 0];
  cr.spine = [16 * D, 0, 0];
  cr.chest = [10 * D, 0, 0];
  cr.armL = { ...cr.armL, sw: 0.5, el: 0.5 };
  cr.armR = { ...cr.armR, sw: 0.5, el: 0.5 };
  const p = k < 0.5 ? blend(st, cr, smooth(k * 2)) : blend(cr, se, smooth((k - 0.5) * 2));
  const fl = footAt(standPos, seat.yaw, -1, spec, 0, 0.03), fr = footAt(standPos, seat.yaw, 1, spec, 0, 0.03);
  p.legL = { ...p.legL, ik: { t: fl.t, q: fl.q, w: 1 } };
  p.legR = { ...p.legR, ik: { t: fr.t, q: fr.q, w: 1 } };
  if (mod) mod(p, t);
  return p;
};

==== 9724 src/kits/characterflow/locomotion/walk.ts
// Locomotion: characters really walk through the set — no treadmill, no sliding feet.
//
// A Walker integrates a speed profile (m/s keys) into distance and gait phase. Step length follows
// speed, so cadence and stride change together; when the speed drops to zero the gait finishes its
// step and both feet come to rest. Each foot is planted at the body's position at mid-stance and
// swings to its next plant with a lift arc, toe-off and heel strike; the legs reach the plants with
// IK (skeleton.ts), so foot contact is exact. walkBody() layers the upper-body motion on any body
// preset: pelvis bob and yaw, counter-rotating chest, arm swing (unless a gesture owns the arm).
//
// Pure maths (no rendering), so the sound department can place footsteps on the same plants.

import { BODY, type BodyName } from "../character/presets/bodies.ts";
import { clonePose, type Pose } from "../character/pose.ts";
import { DIMS, type CharacterSpec, type V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";

export type SpeedKey = [t: number, v: number];
export type WalkerDef = {
  /** ground point where distance 0 is */
  start: V3;
  /** horizontal travel direction (normalised internally) */
  dir: V3;
  /** speed keys (m/s), eased between keys */
  speed: SpeedKey[];
  spec: CharacterSpec;
  /** distance already covered at speed[0][0] */
  d0?: number;
  /** gait phase at speed[0][0] (cycles) — continue another walker's stride */
  phi0?: number;
  /** sideways offset from the line (m, + = his right) over time — lane changes */
  lane?: (t: number) => number;
};
export type Foot = { t: V3; q: [number, number, number, number]; lift: number; planted: boolean };
export type WalkState = { d: number; v: number; phi: number; pos: V3; yaw: number; amt: number };

const DT = 1 / 240;
const smooth = (x: number) => { const k = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x)); return k * k * (3 - 2 * k); };
const smoother = (x: number) => { const k = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x)); return k * k * k * (k * (k * 6 - 15) + 10); };

/** Step length (m) at speed v for a character of this scale. */
export const stepLength = (v: number, scale: number) => Math.min(0.8, Math.max(0.3, 0.3 + 0.38 * v)) * (scale / 0.94);
const ankleH = (spec: CharacterSpec) => 0.087 * spec.scale;

const quatYXZ = (yaw: number, pitch: number): [number, number, number, number] => {
  const cy = Math.cos(yaw / 2), sy = Math.sin(yaw / 2), cx = Math.cos(pitch / 2), sx = Math.sin(pitch / 2);
  // q = qy * qx
  return [cy * sx, sy * cx, -sy * sx, cy * cx];
};

export class Walker {
  def: WalkerDef;
  t0: number;
  dir: V3;
  right: V3;
  yaw: number;
  private d: Float64Array;
  private phi: Float64Array;
  private v: Float64Array;

  constructor(def: WalkerDef, t1: number) {
    this.def = def;
    this.t0 = def.speed[0][0];
    const l = Math.hypot(def.dir[0], def.dir[2]);
    this.dir = [def.dir[0] / l, 0, def.dir[2] / l];
    this.right = [-this.dir[2], 0, this.dir[0]];
    this.yaw = Math.atan2(this.dir[0], this.dir[2]);
    const n = Math.ceil((t1 - this.t0) / DT) + 2;
    this.d = new Float64Array(n);
    this.phi = new Float64Array(n);
    this.v = new Float64Array(n);
    let d = def.d0 ?? 0, phi = def.phi0 ?? 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const t = this.t0 + i * DT;
      const v = this.speedAt(t);
      this.d[i] = d;
      this.phi[i] = phi;
      this.v[i] = v;
      const L = stepLength(v, def.spec.scale);
      let rate = v / (2 * L);
      // stopping: finish the current step so both feet end on the ground (rest at φ ≡ 0.06 mod 0.5)
      if (v < 0.04) {
        const u = (((phi - 0.06) % 0.5) + 0.5) % 0.5;
        rate = u > 0.012 ? Math.max(rate, 0.9) : 0;
      }
      d += v * DT;
      phi += rate * DT;
    }
  }

  speedAt(t: number) {
    const k = this.def.speed;
    if (t <= k[0][0]) return k[0][1];
    for (let i = 1; i < k.length; i++) if (t <= k[i][0]) return k[i - 1][1] + (k[i][1] - k[i - 1][1]) * smooth((t - k[i - 1][0]) / (k[i][0] - k[i - 1][0]));
    return k[k.length - 1][1];
  }

  private sample(arr: Float64Array, t: number) {
    const x = Math.min(arr.length - 1.001, Math.max(0, (t - this.t0) / DT));
    const i = Math.floor(x), f = x - i;
    return arr[i] * (1 - f) + arr[i + 1] * f;
  }
  /** distance at the moment the phase reaches `p` (binary search; phase is monotonic) */
  private dAtPhase(p: number) {
    const a = this.phi;
    if (p <= a[0]) return this.d[0] - (a[0] - p) * 2 * stepLength(this.v[0], this.def.spec.scale);
    let lo = 0, hi = a.length - 1;
    if (p >= a[hi]) return this.d[hi];
    while (hi - lo > 1) { const m = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (a[m] < p) lo = m; else hi = m; }
    const f = (p - a[lo]) / Math.max(1e-9, a[hi] - a[lo]);
    return this.d[lo] + (this.d[hi] - this.d[lo]) * f;
  }
  private at3(d: number, lateral = 0, t = this.t0): V3 {
    const s = this.def.start;
    lateral += this.def.lane ? this.def.lane(t) : 0;
    return [s[0] + this.dir[0] * d + this.right[0] * lateral, s[1], s[2] + this.dir[2] * d + this.right[2] * lateral];
  }

  at(t: number): WalkState {
    const d = this.sample(this.d, t), v = this.sample(this.v, t), phi = this.sample(this.phi, t);
    return { d, v, phi, pos: this.at3(d, 0, t), yaw: this.yaw, amt: Math.min(1.2, v / 1.0) };
  }

  /** Ankle targets + foot orientations for both feet at time t. */
  feet(t: number): { L: Foot; R: Foot } {
    const st = this.at(t);
    const spec = this.def.spec;
    const gap = 0.1 * spec.scale;
    const foot = (off: number, side: 1 | -1): Foot => {
      const pf = st.phi + off;
      const n = Math.floor(pf), u = pf - n;
      const plant = (k: number) => this.dAtPhase(k + 0.3 - off) - 0.04;
      let dd: number, lift = 0, pitch = 0, planted = true;
      if (u < 0.6) {
        dd = plant(n);
        pitch = 0.16 * smooth((u - 0.42) / 0.18) * Math.min(1, st.v / 0.4); // heel rises late in stance
      } else {
        const k = smoother((u - 0.6) / 0.4);
        dd = plant(n) + (plant(n + 1) - plant(n)) * k;
        const amp = Math.min(1, 0.25 + st.v / 0.6);
        lift = 0.075 * Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * amp;
        pitch = 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * k) * Math.sqrt(Math.sin(Math.PI * k)) * amp;
        planted = false;
      }
      const p = this.at3(dd, side * gap, t);
      const y = p[1] + ankleH(spec) + lift + Math.max(0, pitch) * 0.12 + Math.max(0, -pitch) * 0.05;
      return { t: [p[0], y, p[2]], q: quatYXZ(this.yaw - side * 0.07, pitch), lift, planted };
    };
    // `right` points to his right: left foot −gap, right foot +gap; toes turn slightly out
    return { L: foot(0, -1), R: foot(0.5, 1) };
  }

  /** Times (s) of heel strikes in [a, b] — for footstep sounds. */
  heelStrikes(a: number, b: number): { t: number; side: "L" | "R" }[] {
    const out: { t: number; side: "L" | "R" }[] = [];
    let prevL = this.sample(this.phi, a), prevR = prevL + 0.5;
    for (let t = a + DT; t <= b; t += DT) {
      const p = this.sample(this.phi, t);
      if (Math.floor(p) > Math.floor(prevL) && this.sample(this.v, t) > 0.02) out.push({ t, side: "L" });
      if (Math.floor(p + 0.5) > Math.floor(prevR) && this.sample(this.v, t) > 0.02) out.push({ t, side: "R" });
      prevL = p; prevR = p + 0.5;
    }
    return out;
  }
}

/** Distance covered at time t by a speed profile (no walker needed). */
export const distanceAt = (speed: SpeedKey[], t: number, d0 = 0) => {
  const w = { speedAt: Walker.prototype.speedAt, def: { speed } } as unknown as Walker;
  let d = d0;
  for (let x = speed[0][0]; x < t; x += DT) d += w.speedAt(x) * DT;
  return d;
};

/**
 * Scale the cruise speed of a profile so the walk covers exactly `dist` by `tEnd`
 * (`keys(v)` builds the profile for a cruise speed v; bisection, deterministic).
 */
export const fitCruise = (keys: (v: number) => SpeedKey[], dist: number, tEnd: number) => {
  let lo = 0.05, hi = 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const m = (lo + hi) / 2;
    if (distanceAt(keys(m), tEnd) < dist) lo = m; else hi = m;
  }
  return keys((lo + hi) / 2);
};

const D = Math.PI / 180;

/**
 * A walking body: `base` preset at the walker's position, plus gait motion and planted legs.
 * `amtOverride` scales the upper-body swing (e.g. smaller while holding a phone).
 */
export const walkBody = (w: Walker, base: BodyName = "stand", mod?: (p: Pose, t: number) => void) => (t: number): Pose => {
  const st = w.at(t);
  const spec = w.def.spec;
  const p = clonePose(BODY[base]({ x: st.pos[0], y: st.pos[1], z: st.pos[2], yaw: st.yaw }, spec, t));
  const a = Math.min(1, st.amt);
  const c = Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * st.phi);
  p.hipY = p.hipY - 0.008 - 0.024 * a + 0.011 * a * Math.cos(4 * Math.PI * (st.phi - 0.3));
  p.hips = [p.hips[0] + 3 * D * a, p.hips[1] - 6 * D * a * c, p.hips[2] + 2.2 * D * a * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * (st.phi - 0.3))];
  p.chest = [p.chest[0] + 1.5 * D * a, p.chest[1] + 8 * D * a * c, p.chest[2]];
  p.neck = [p.neck[0] - 1 * D * a, p.neck[1] - 2 * D * a * c, p.neck[2]];
  p.armL = { ...p.armL, sw: p.armL.sw - 0.34 * a * c, el: p.armL.el + 0.1 * a + 0.12 * a * Math.max(0, -c) };
  p.armR = { ...p.armR, sw: p.armR.sw + 0.34 * a * c, el: p.armR.el + 0.1 * a + 0.12 * a * Math.max(0, c) };
  const f = w.feet(t);
  p.legL = { ...p.legL, ik: { t: f.L.t, q: f.L.q, w: 1 } };
  p.legR = { ...p.legR, ik: { t: f.R.t, q: f.R.q, w: 1 } };
  if (mod) mod(p, t);
  return p;
};

/** World eye position of a walking character (for look-at between characters, no recursion). */
export const eyeOf = (w: Walker, t: number): V3 => {
  const st = w.at(t);
  const h = (DIMS.pelvisH + DIMS.spineY + DIMS.chestY + DIMS.neckY + DIMS.headY + DIMS.headCenter[1]) * w.def.spec.scale;
  return [st.pos[0] + w.dir[0] * 0.08, st.pos[1] + h - 0.03, st.pos[2] + w.dir[2] * 0.08];
};

export const CharLook: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps } = useVideoConfig();
  const card = CARDS[Math.min(CARDS.length - 1, frame)];
  const spec = card.spec ?? RAKA;
  const t = 1.3 + frame * 0.37;
  const anchor = card.body === "lie" || card.body.startsWith("sit") ? { x: 0, y: 0.5, z: 0, yaw: 0 } : { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, yaw: card.yaw ?? 0 };
  const beats: Beat[] = [{ at: 0, body: card.body, armL: card.armL ?? "rest", armR: card.armR ?? "rest", face: card.face, nervous: 0, breath: { amp: 0.3 } }];
  const perf = { spec, anchor, beats };
  const { pose } = perform(perf, t);
  if (card.cam === "face" || card.cam === "face34" || card.cam === "profile") pose.face = { ...EXPR[card.face], eyeX: card.cam === "face" ? 0 : pose.face.eyeX, eyeY: 0 };
  const sk = skeleton(pose, spec, t);
  const fp = facePoint(sk);
  let cam: Cam;
  if (card.cam === "full") cam = { pos: [0, 1.0, 5.6], target: [0, 0.88, 0], fov: 26 };
  else if (card.cam === "face") cam = { pos: [fp[0], fp[1] + 0.03, fp[2] + 1.6], target: [fp[0], fp[1] + 0.01, fp[2]], fov: 17 };
  else if (card.cam === "face34") cam = { pos: [fp[0] + 1.0, fp[1] + 0.08, fp[2] + 1.25], target: [fp[0], fp[1] + 0.01, fp[2] - 0.03], fov: 17 };
  else if (card.cam === "profile") cam = { pos: [fp[0] + 1.6, fp[1] + 0.03, fp[2] - 0.05], target: [fp[0], fp[1] + 0.01, fp[2] - 0.07], fov: 17 };
  else if (card.cam === "bed") cam = { pos: [1.6, 1.9, 1.6], target: [0, 0.6, -0.15], fov: 30 };
  else cam = { pos: [0.9, 1.25, 2.6], target: [0, 0.92, 0.1], fov: 30 };
  return (
    <Stage3D background="#d9dde4" overlay={() => (
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 40, top: 40, fontFamily: FONT, fontSize: 40, fontWeight: 600, color: "#2a2f38" }}>
        {card.title}
        <div style={{ fontSize: 26, fontWeight: 500, opacity: 0.6 }}>CHARACTERFLOW · {spec.id} · card {frame} · {fps} fps</div>
      </div>
    )}>
      <Lights s={L} />
      <mesh geometry={cyl(3, 3, 0.02, 64)} material={phys("lookFloor", { color: "#c9ccd2", roughness: 0.9 })} position={[0, -0.01, 0]} receiveShadow />
      {anchor.y > 0 ? <mesh geometry={box(1.4, 0.5, 2.1, 0.08)} material={phys("lookBed", { color: "#e8e6e1", roughness: 0.9 })} position={[0, 0.25, 0.2]} receiveShadow castShadow /> : null}
      <Character pose={pose} spec={spec} t={t} />
      <CameraRig cam={cam} />
      <FilmPost cam={cam} grade={{ ...GRADE0, exposure: 1.0, vignette: 0.12, grain: 0.01, bloom: 0.12, bloomThreshold: 1.2 }} frame={frame} />
    </Stage3D>
  );
};

==== 1671 src/kits/characterflow/props/attach.ts
// Prop attach maths (pure, Node-safe): a prop's world matrix is a chain of states — resting
// somewhere, or held by a hand. When a hand takes a prop the grip offset is measured at that instant
// (prop rest × inverse hand), so the prop never jumps; when let go it settles onto its next rest pose.

import { Euler, Matrix4, Quaternion, Vector3 } from "three";
import type { V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";

export const mat = (p: V3, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, roll = 0) => {
  const q = new Quaternion().setFromEuler(new Euler(pitch, yaw, roll, "YXZ"));
  return new Matrix4().compose(new Vector3(...p), q, new Vector3(1, 1, 1));
};
export const lerpMat = (a: Matrix4, b: Matrix4, k: number) => {
  if (k <= 0) return a.clone();
  if (k >= 1) return b.clone();
  const pa = new Vector3(), qa = new Quaternion(), sa = new Vector3(), pb = new Vector3(), qb = new Quaternion(), sb = new Vector3();
  a.decompose(pa, qa, sa);
  b.decompose(pb, qb, sb);
  return new Matrix4().compose(pa.lerp(pb, k), qa.slerp(qb, k), sa.lerp(sb, k));
};
/** Offset that keeps `prop` where it is when attached to `hand`. */
export const gripOffset = (hand: Matrix4, prop: Matrix4) => hand.clone().invert().multiply(prop);
export const held = (hand: Matrix4, offset: Matrix4) => hand.clone().multiply(offset);
export const toPQ = (m: Matrix4) => {
  const p = new Vector3(), q = new Quaternion(), s = new Vector3();
  m.decompose(p, q, s);
  return { position: [p.x, p.y, p.z] as V3, quaternion: [q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w] as [number, number, number, number] };
};
export const xform = (m: Matrix4, local: V3): V3 => {
  const v = new Vector3(...local).applyMatrix4(m);
  return [v.x, v.y, v.z];
};


==== 2360 src/kits/characterflow/props/grip.ts
// Hand-prop poses (pure, Node-safe): the phone held in a right palm, the reading pose, and
// `gripFor` — derive the HAND from where the prop must be (wrist target + hand orientation for IK).

import { Matrix4, Quaternion, Vector3 } from "three";
import type { V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";

export const PHONE = { w: 0.072, h: 0.152, t: 0.009 };
export const BAG = { w: 0.3, h: 0.21, d: 0.085 };

/** Phone lying in a RIGHT palm (hand space): back on the palm (+X side), top toward the fingertips. */
export const PHONE_IN_HAND = (() => {
  const yAxis = new Vector3(0, -1, 0), zAxis = new Vector3(1, 0, 0);
  const xAxis = new Vector3().crossVectors(yAxis, zAxis);
  const q = new Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(new Matrix4().makeBasis(xAxis, yAxis, zAxis));
  return new Matrix4().compose(new Vector3(0.024, -0.085, 0.005), q, new Vector3(1, 1, 1));
})();

/**
 * Wrist target + hand orientation (world) that put `propInHand` at the world pose `prop`.
 * `handScale` = character scale × spec.handScale (the wrist frame is scaled by both).
 */
export const gripFor = (prop: Matrix4, propInHand: Matrix4, handScale: number) => {
  const pp = new Vector3(), pq = new Quaternion(), ps = new Vector3();
  prop.decompose(pp, pq, ps);
  const lp = new Vector3(), lq = new Quaternion(), ls = new Vector3();
  propInHand.decompose(lp, lq, ls);
  const hq = pq.clone().multiply(lq.clone().invert());
  const wrist = pp.clone().sub(lp.clone().multiplyScalar(handScale).applyQuaternion(hq));
  return { wrist: [wrist.x, wrist.y, wrist.z] as V3, q: [hq.x, hq.y, hq.z, hq.w] as [number, number, number, number] };
};

/** Phone held up to read: in front of and below the eyes, screen turned to them. */
export const phoneReadPose = (eye: V3, forward: V3, right: V3, lower = 0.27, out = 0.27, side = -0.04) => {
  const f = new Vector3(...forward).setY(0).normalize();
  const r = new Vector3(...right).normalize();
  const p = new Vector3(...eye).addScaledVector(f, out).add(new Vector3(0, -lower, 0)).addScaledVector(r, side);
  const z = new Vector3(...eye).sub(p).normalize();
  const y = new Vector3(0, 1, 0).addScaledVector(z, -z.y).normalize();
  const x = new Vector3().crossVectors(y, z).normalize();
  const q = new Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(new Matrix4().makeBasis(x, y, z));
  return new Matrix4().compose(p, q, new Vector3(1, 1, 1));
};


==== 5555 src/kits/characterflow/props/handheld.tsx
// Everyday hand props: a phone and a crossbody sling bag (with a live strap). The grip rule from the
// notebook pen applies: when a prop's pose matters (a phone held up to the eyes), the HAND is derived
// from the prop — `gripFor` returns the wrist target + hand orientation for arm IK.

import React from "react";
import { type Matrix4, PlaneGeometry, Quaternion, Vector3 } from "three";
import { box, cached, cyl, sphere } from "../lib/geo.ts";
import { canvasTex, phys } from "../lib/mats.ts";
import { FONT } from "../../../core/type/fonts.ts";
import { toPQ } from "./attach.ts";
import { BAG, PHONE } from "./grip.ts";
export { BAG, PHONE, PHONE_IN_HAND, gripFor, phoneReadPose } from "./grip.ts";
import type { V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";

// ── phone ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const homeTex = (clock: string) =>
  canvasTex(`cfhome${clock}`, 256, 540, (g, w, h) => {
    const gr = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, h);
    gr.addColorStop(0, "#5b8def");
    gr.addColorStop(0.55, "#9b6be8");
    gr.addColorStop(1, "#f08aa7");
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    g.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    g.textAlign = "center";
    g.font = `300 64px ${FONT}, sans-serif`;
    g.fillText(clock, w / 2, 110);
    g.font = `500 16px ${FONT}, sans-serif`;
    g.fillText("Jumat, 31 Oktober", w / 2, 138);
    const cols = ["#ffd166", "#06d6a0", "#ef476f", "#118ab2", "#ffffff", "#f78c6b", "#83d483", "#c3a6ff"];
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const x = 38 + (i % 4) * 60, y = 220 + Math.floor(i / 4) * 72;
      g.fillStyle = cols[i % cols.length];
      g.beginPath();
      g.roundRect(x - 20, y - 20, 40, 40, 11);
      g.fill();
    }
    g.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
    g.beginPath();
    g.roundRect(18, h - 78, w - 36, 56, 22);
    g.fill();
  });

/** Phone: centre at the origin, screen faces +Z, top toward +Y. */
export const Phone: React.FC<{ m: Matrix4; on: number; clock?: string }> = ({ m, on, clock = "07:42" }) => {
  const { position, quaternion } = toPQ(m);
  const scr = phys(`cfphonescr${clock}`, { color: "#000000", emissive: "#ffffff", emissiveMap: homeTex(clock), emissiveIntensity: 1, roughness: 0.15, clearcoat: 1 });
  scr.emissiveIntensity = 0.15 + 0.75 * on;
  return (
    <group position={position} quaternion={quaternion}>
      <mesh geometry={box(PHONE.w, PHONE.h, PHONE.t, 0.009)} material={phys("cfphonebody", { color: "#2a2d36", roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.5, clearcoat: 0.6 })} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={cached("cfphonescreen", () => new PlaneGeometry(PHONE.w - 0.006, PHONE.h - 0.008))} material={scr} position={[0, 0, PHONE.t / 2 + 0.0004]} />
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.007, 0.007, 0.002, 16)} material={phys("cfphonecam", { color: "#111", roughness: 0.1, clearcoat: 1 })} position={[-0.02, 0.058, -PHONE.t / 2 - 0.0008]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── sling bag ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Sling bag: origin at the centre of its top edge, front faces +Z, hangs along −Y. */
export const SlingBag: React.FC<{ m: Matrix4; flap: number; color?: string }> = ({ m, flap, color = "#e07a3f" }) => {
  const { position, quaternion } = toPQ(m);
  const body = phys(`cfbag${color}`, { color, roughness: 0.75, sheen: 0.6, sheenColor: "#ffd7b5" });
  const dark = phys("cfbagtrim", { color: "#5b3a29", roughness: 0.6 });
  const a = -2.3 * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, flap));
  return (
    <group position={position} quaternion={quaternion}>
      <mesh geometry={box(BAG.w, BAG.h, BAG.d, 0.03)} material={body} position={[0, -BAG.h / 2, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={box(BAG.w - 0.04, 0.012, BAG.d - 0.03, 0.005)} material={phys("cfbaginside", { color: "#3a2a22", roughness: 0.9 })} position={[0, -0.004, 0]} />
      {/* flap hinged at the back of the top edge */}
      <group position={[0, 0.004, -BAG.d / 2]} rotation={[a, 0, 0]}>
        <mesh geometry={box(BAG.w + 0.008, 0.012, BAG.d + 0.004, 0.005)} material={body} position={[0, 0, BAG.d / 2]} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={box(BAG.w + 0.01, 0.13, 0.012, 0.005)} material={body} position={[0, -0.065, BAG.d + 0.004]} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={box(0.05, 0.03, 0.006, 0.004)} material={dark} position={[0, -0.11, BAG.d + 0.012]} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

/** Strap as a tube through world points. */
export const Strap: React.FC<{ pts: V3[]; r?: number; color?: string }> = ({ pts, r = 0.011, color = "#5b3a29" }) => {
  const mat = phys(`cfstrap${color}`, { color, roughness: 0.7 });
  const up = new Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  return (
    <group>
      {pts.slice(1).map((b, i) => {
        const a = new Vector3(...pts[i]), c = new Vector3(...b);
        const len = a.distanceTo(c);
        const mid = a.clone().add(c).multiplyScalar(0.5);
        const q = new Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(up, c.clone().sub(a).normalize());
        return <mesh key={i} geometry={cyl(r, r, 1, 8)} material={mat} position={[mid.x, mid.y, mid.z]} quaternion={[q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w]} scale={[1.6, len, 0.55]} castShadow />;
      })}
      {pts.map((p, i) => <mesh key={`j${i}`} geometry={sphere(r * 1.05, 8, 6)} material={mat} position={p} scale={[1.6, 1, 0.55]} />)}
    </group>
  );
};

==== 7265 src/kits/characterflow/props/props.tsx
// Hand props + the attach maths that lets a character pick things up and put them down.
//
// A prop's world matrix over time is a chain of states: resting somewhere, or held by a hand. When a
// hand takes a prop, the grip offset is measured at that instant (prop rest × inverse hand), so the
// prop never jumps; when it is let go it settles onto its next rest pose. All pure functions of t.

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { CanvasTexture, DoubleSide, type Matrix4, PlaneGeometry, SRGBColorSpace } from "three";
import { box, cached, cyl, sphere } from "../lib/geo.ts";
import { phys } from "../lib/mats.ts";

export { mat, lerpMat, gripOffset, held, toPQ, xform } from "./attach.ts";
import { toPQ } from "./attach.ts";

// ── notebook with live handwriting ──────────────────────────────────────────
export const NB = { w: 0.15, d: 0.21, t: 0.014 };
const CW = 600, CH = Math.round((CW * NB.d) / NB.w);

export type Writing = { header: string; lines: string[]; checkbox: boolean; font: string; ink: string };

type Layout = { x0: number; y: number; w: number }[];
const layoutLines = (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, W: Writing): Layout => {
  g.font = `64px ${W.font}`;
  const out: Layout = [];
  let y = 300;
  W.lines.forEach((ln, i) => {
    const x0 = i === 0 && W.checkbox ? 130 : 70;
    out.push({ x0, y, w: g.measureText(ln).width });
    y += 96;
  });
  return out;
};
const totalLen = (L: Layout, W: Writing) => L.reduce((s, l) => s + l.w, 0) + (W.checkbox ? 160 : 0);

/** Page-space (0…1) position of the pen tip for writing progress p. */
export const penOnPage = (W: Writing, p: number): [number, number] => {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas").getContext("2d")!;
  const L = layoutLines(c, W);
  let d = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p)) * totalLen(L, W);
  if (W.checkbox) {
    if (d < 160) {
      const k = d / 160, s = 50;
      const [x, y] = k < 0.25 ? [70 + s * (k / 0.25), 250] : k < 0.5 ? [70 + s, 250 + s * ((k - 0.25) / 0.25)] : k < 0.75 ? [70 + s - s * ((k - 0.5) / 0.25), 250 + s] : [70, 250 + s - s * ((k - 0.75) / 0.25)];
      return [x / CW, y / CH];
    }
    d -= 160;
  }
  for (const l of L) {
    if (d <= l.w) {
      const wob = Math.sin(d * 0.21) * 9 + Math.sin(d * 0.057) * 6;
      return [(l.x0 + d) / CW, (l.y - 14 + wob) / CH];
    }
    d -= l.w;
  }
  const last = L[L.length - 1];
  return [(last.x0 + last.w + 6) / CW, (last.y - 10) / CH];
};

const drawPage = (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, W: Writing, p: number) => {
  g.fillStyle = "#fbf8f0";
  g.fillRect(0, 0, CW, CH);
  g.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,140,200,0.35)";
  g.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let y = 210; y < CH - 30; y += 96) {
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(30, y + 112);
    g.lineTo(CW - 30, y + 112);
    g.stroke();
  }
  g.strokeStyle = "rgba(230,90,90,0.45)";
  g.beginPath();
  g.moveTo(52, 0);
  g.lineTo(52, CH);
  g.stroke();
  g.fillStyle = "rgba(60,70,90,0.55)";
  g.font = `600 30px Manrope, sans-serif`;
  g.textAlign = "right";
  g.fillText(W.header, CW - 40, 120);
  g.textAlign = "left";
  const L = layoutLines(g, W);
  let d = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p)) * totalLen(L, W);
  g.strokeStyle = W.ink;
  g.fillStyle = W.ink;
  g.lineWidth = 6;
  g.lineCap = "round";
  if (W.checkbox) {
    const k = Math.min(1, d / 160), s = 50;
    g.beginPath();
    const pts: [number, number][] = [[70, 250], [70 + s, 252], [72 + s, 250 + s], [69, 249 + s], [70, 250]];
    const segs = 4 * k;
    g.moveTo(...pts[0]);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      if (segs <= i) break;
      const f = Math.min(1, segs - i);
      g.lineTo(pts[i][0] + (pts[i + 1][0] - pts[i][0]) * f, pts[i][1] + (pts[i + 1][1] - pts[i][1]) * f);
    }
    g.stroke();
    d -= 160;
  }
  g.font = `64px ${W.font}`;
  W.lines.forEach((ln, i) => {
    const l = L[i];
    if (d <= 0) return;
    const show = Math.min(l.w, d);
    g.save();
    g.beginPath();
    g.rect(l.x0 - 10, l.y - 90, show + 12, 140);
    g.clip();
    g.fillText(ln, l.x0, l.y);
    g.restore();
    d -= l.w;
  });
};

export const Notebook: React.FC<{ m: Matrix4; open: number; writing: Writing; progress: number }> = ({ m, open, writing, progress }) => {
  const page = useMemo(() => {
    const c = document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width = CW;
    c.height = CH;
    const tex = new CanvasTexture(c);
    tex.colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace;
    tex.anisotropy = 8;
    return { c, tex, last: -1 };
  }, []);
  const q = Math.round(progress * 400) / 400;
  if (q !== page.last) {
    drawPage(page.c.getContext("2d")!, writing, q);
    page.tex.needsUpdate = true;
    page.last = q;
  }
  const pageMat = phys("cfnbpage", { color: "#ffffff", roughness: 0.75, side: DoubleSide });
  pageMat.map = page.tex;
  const cover = phys("cfnbcover", { color: "#e4572e", roughness: 0.55, clearcoat: 0.3 });
  const { position, quaternion } = toPQ(m);
  const ang = Math.PI * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, open));
  return (
    <group position={position} quaternion={quaternion}>
      <mesh geometry={box(NB.w, 0.004, NB.d, 0.002)} material={cover} position={[0, 0.002, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={box(NB.w - 0.006, NB.t - 0.006, NB.d - 0.006, 0.002)} material={phys("cfnbpages", { color: "#f4efe2", roughness: 0.9 })} position={[0, NB.t / 2, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={cached("cfnbpageplane", () => new PlaneGeometry(NB.w - 0.008, NB.d - 0.008))} material={pageMat} position={[0, NB.t - 0.0025, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
      {/* spiral along the left edge */}
      {Array.from({ length: 11 }, (_, k) => (
        <mesh key={k} geometry={cyl(0.0035, 0.0035, 0.004, 8)} material={phys("cfspiral", { color: "#cfd3d8", metalness: 0.9, roughness: 0.25 })} position={[-NB.w / 2, NB.t / 2, -NB.d / 2 + 0.012 + k * 0.0186]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} scale={[1, 1, 2.2]} />
      ))}
      {/* cover hinges on the left edge and folds under */}
      <group position={[-NB.w / 2, NB.t, 0]} rotation={[0, 0, ang]}>
        <mesh geometry={box(NB.w, 0.004, NB.d, 0.002)} material={cover} position={[NB.w / 2, 0.002, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
        <mesh geometry={box(0.05, 0.0012, NB.d * 0.7, 0.0005)} material={phys("cfnblabel", { color: "#fff3d6", roughness: 0.7 })} position={[NB.w / 2 + 0.03, 0.0048, 0]} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

/** Ball pen; tip at the local origin, body along +Y. */
export const Pen: React.FC<{ m: Matrix4 }> = ({ m }) => {
  const { position, quaternion } = toPQ(m);
  return (
    <group position={position} quaternion={quaternion}>
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.0012, 0.0035, 0.012, 10)} material={phys("cfpentip", { color: "#c9ccd2", metalness: 0.9, roughness: 0.25 })} position={[0, 0.006, 0]} />
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.0048, 0.0048, 0.11, 14)} material={phys("cfpen", { color: "#2b59c3", roughness: 0.3, clearcoat: 0.7 })} position={[0, 0.067, 0]} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={sphere(0.0048, 12, 8)} material={phys("cfpen", { color: "#2b59c3" })} position={[0, 0.122, 0]} />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.0016, 0.045, 0.004, 0.0008)} material={phys("cfpenclip", { color: "#e8e8ea", metalness: 0.9, roughness: 0.2 })} position={[0.0055, 0.1, 0]} />
    </group>
  );
};

==== 7543 src/kits/characterflow/render/FilmPost.tsx
// Camera + finishing chain (adapted from core/render/Post.tsx): MSAA → NaN guard → GTAO
// → bokeh DOF → bloom → PBR Neutral tone map → film grade. The grade is driven per shot and
// carries flash / fade for transitions.

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useFrame, useThree } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { Color, HalfFloatType, NeutralToneMapping, PerspectiveCamera, Vector2, Vector3, WebGLRenderTarget } from "three";
import { EffectComposer } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js";
import { RenderPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js";
import { GTAOPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/GTAOPass.js";
import { BokehPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/BokehPass.js";
import { UnrealBloomPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js";
import { OutputPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/OutputPass.js";
import { ShaderPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/ShaderPass.js";
import { FX_LAYER, withoutFx } from "../../../core/render/Post.tsx";
import type { V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";

export type Cam = { pos: V3; target: V3; fov: number; roll?: number; focus?: number; aperture?: number; maxBlur?: number; near?: number; far?: number };

export type Grade = {
  exposure: number;
  /** additive lift in the shadows, multiplicative gain */
  lift: V3; gain: V3;
  sat: number; contrast: number;
  vignette: number; grain: number;
  bloom: number; bloomRadius: number; bloomThreshold: number;
  /** 0..1 flash toward `flashColor`, 0..1 fade to black */
  flash: number; flashColor: string; black: number;
  ao: number;
};

export const GRADE0: Grade = {
  exposure: 1, lift: [0, 0, 0], gain: [1, 1, 1], sat: 1, contrast: 1, vignette: 0.22, grain: 0.016,
  bloom: 0.22, bloomRadius: 0.45, bloomThreshold: 1.05, flash: 0, flashColor: "#ffffff", black: 0, ao: 1,
};

export const CameraRig: React.FC<{ cam: Cam }> = ({ cam }) => {
  const { camera } = useThree();
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const c = camera as PerspectiveCamera;
    c.position.set(...cam.pos);
    const f = new Vector3(...cam.target).sub(c.position).normalize();
    const r = cam.roll ?? 0;
    // roll about the view axis
    const up = new Vector3(0, 1, 0);
    const side = new Vector3().crossVectors(f, up).normalize();
    const u2 = new Vector3().crossVectors(side, f).normalize();
    c.up.copy(u2.multiplyScalar(Math.cos(r)).addScaledVector(side, Math.sin(r)));
    c.lookAt(...cam.target);
    c.fov = cam.fov;
    c.near = cam.near ?? 0.05;
    c.far = cam.far ?? 900;
    c.updateProjectionMatrix();
    c.updateMatrixWorld();
    c.layers.enable(FX_LAYER);
  }, [cam, camera]);
  return null;
};

const NanGuardShader = {
  uniforms: { tDiffuse: { value: null } },
  vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `uniform sampler2D tDiffuse; varying vec2 vUv;
    void main(){ vec4 c = texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv);
      if (any(isnan(c)) || any(isinf(c))) c = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
      gl_FragColor = clamp(c, 0.0, 64.0); }`,
};

const GradeShader = {
  uniforms: {
    tDiffuse: { value: null },
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uRes: { value: new Vector2(1080, 1920) },
    uLift: { value: new Vector3() },
    uGain: { value: new Vector3(1, 1, 1) },
    uSat: { value: 1 },
    uContrast: { value: 1 },
    uVignette: { value: 0.2 },
    uGrain: { value: 0.015 },
    uFlash: { value: 0 },
    uFlashColor: { value: new Color("#fff") },
    uBlack: { value: 0 },
  },
  vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
    uniform sampler2D tDiffuse; uniform float uTime; uniform vec2 uRes;
    uniform vec3 uLift; uniform vec3 uGain; uniform float uSat; uniform float uContrast;
    uniform float uVignette; uniform float uGrain; uniform float uFlash; uniform vec3 uFlashColor; uniform float uBlack;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    float hash(vec2 p){ p = fract(p * vec2(443.897, 441.423)); p += dot(p, p.yx + 19.19); return fract((p.x + p.y) * p.x); }
    void main(){
      vec4 c = texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv);
      vec3 x = clamp(c.rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
      x = x * uGain + uLift * (1.0 - x);
      float l = dot(x, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
      x = mix(vec3(l), x, uSat);
      x = clamp((x - 0.5) * uContrast + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
      x = mix(x, x * x * (3.0 - 2.0 * x), 0.18);
      vec2 d = (vUv - 0.5) * vec2(1.0, 1.15);
      x *= 1.0 - uVignette * smoothstep(0.3, 0.95, length(d));
      float g = hash(vUv * uRes + uTime * 17.0) - 0.5;
      x += g * uGrain * (0.5 + 0.5 * (1.0 - l));
      x = mix(x, uFlashColor, clamp(uFlash, 0.0, 1.0));
      x *= 1.0 - clamp(uBlack, 0.0, 1.0);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(x, 1.0);
    }`,
};

export const FilmPost: React.FC<{ cam: Cam; grade: Grade; frame: number }> = ({ cam, grade, frame }) => {
  const { gl, scene, camera, size } = useThree();
  const chain = useMemo(() => {
    const w = size.width, h = size.height;
    const rt = new WebGLRenderTarget(w, h, { type: HalfFloatType, samples: 4 });
    const composer = new EffectComposer(gl, rt);
    composer.setPixelRatio(1);
    composer.setSize(w, h);
    composer.addPass(new RenderPass(scene, camera));
    composer.addPass(new ShaderPass(NanGuardShader));
    const gtao = new GTAOPass(scene, camera, w, h);
    gtao.blendIntensity = 1.0;
    gtao.updateGtaoMaterial({ radius: 0.35, distanceExponent: 1.6, thickness: 0.6, scale: 1.0, samples: 16, distanceFallOff: 1.0, screenSpaceRadius: false });
    gtao.updatePdMaterial({ lumaPhi: 10, depthPhi: 2, normalPhi: 3, radius: 5, rings: 2, samples: 16 });
    composer.addPass(withoutFx(gtao, camera));
    const dof = withoutFx(new BokehPass(scene, camera, { focus: 3, aperture: 0.002, maxblur: 0.008 }), camera);
    composer.addPass(dof);
    const bloom = new UnrealBloomPass(new Vector2(w, h), 0.25, 0.5, 0.85);
    composer.addPass(bloom);
    composer.addPass(new OutputPass());
    const g = new ShaderPass(GradeShader);
    g.uniforms.uRes.value.set(w, h);
    composer.addPass(g);
    return { composer, dof, bloom, gtao, g };
  }, [gl, scene, camera, size.width, size.height]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    gl.toneMapping = NeutralToneMapping;
    gl.toneMappingExposure = grade.exposure;
    const u = chain.dof.uniforms as unknown as Record<string, { value: number }>;
    const dist = new Vector3(...cam.pos).distanceTo(new Vector3(...cam.target));
    u.focus.value = cam.focus ?? dist;
    u.aperture.value = cam.aperture ?? 0;
    u.maxblur.value = cam.maxBlur ?? 0;
    chain.dof.enabled = (cam.aperture ?? 0) > 0 && (cam.maxBlur ?? 0) > 0;
    chain.bloom.strength = grade.bloom;
    chain.bloom.radius = grade.bloomRadius;
    chain.bloom.threshold = grade.bloomThreshold;
    chain.gtao.blendIntensity = grade.ao;
    chain.gtao.enabled = grade.ao > 0.01;
    const U = chain.g.uniforms;
    U.uTime.value = frame % 997;
    U.uLift.value.set(...grade.lift);
    U.uGain.value.set(...grade.gain);
    U.uSat.value = grade.sat;
    U.uContrast.value = grade.contrast;
    U.uVignette.value = grade.vignette;
    U.uGrain.value = grade.grain;
    U.uFlash.value = grade.flash;
    U.uFlashColor.value.set(grade.flashColor);
    U.uBlack.value = grade.black;
  }, [frame, chain, cam, grade, gl]);

  useFrame(() => {
    chain.composer.render();
  }, 1);
  return null;
};

==== 5115 src/kits/characterflow/render/Lights.tsx
// Fixed light rig for a whole film. The set of lights never changes (so three.js never recompiles
// a shader mid-film); shots only move them and change colour/intensity. Two lights cast shadows:
// the key (directional, frustum fitted to the shot box) and one spot (a practical lamp).

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useThree } from "@react-three/fiber";
import {
  Color,
  DirectionalLight,
  FogExp2,
  HemisphereLight,
  Matrix4,
  Object3D,
  PMREMGenerator,
  PointLight,
  SpotLight,
  Vector3,
} from "three";
import { RoomEnvironment } from "three/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js";
import type { V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";

export type PointL = { pos: V3; color: string; i: number; dist: number };
export type LightState = {
  bg: string;
  fog: { color: string; density: number };
  env: number;
  hemi: { sky: string; ground: string; i: number };
  moon: { dir: V3; color: string; i: number; box: { min: V3; max: V3 } };
  spot: { pos: V3; target: V3; color: string; i: number; angle: number; penumbra: number; dist: number };
  pts: [PointL, PointL, PointL, PointL];
};

export const P_OFF: PointL = { pos: [0, -50, 0], color: "#ffffff", i: 0, dist: 1 };

export const Lights: React.FC<{ s: LightState }> = ({ s }) => {
  const { scene, gl } = useThree();
  const rig = useMemo(() => {
    const hemi = new HemisphereLight("#8899bb", "#221a14", 0.5);
    const moon = new DirectionalLight("#9fb8ff", 1);
    moon.castShadow = true;
    moon.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    moon.shadow.bias = -0.0004;
    moon.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    moon.shadow.radius = 3;
    const mt = new Object3D();
    moon.target = mt;
    const spot = new SpotLight("#ffd9a8", 0);
    spot.castShadow = true;
    spot.shadow.mapSize.set(1024, 1024);
    spot.shadow.bias = -0.0006;
    spot.shadow.normalBias = 0.02;
    spot.shadow.radius = 4;
    spot.shadow.camera.near = 0.1;
    const st = new Object3D();
    spot.target = st;
    const pts = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(() => {
      const p = new PointLight("#fff", 0, 1, 2);
      p.castShadow = false;
      return p;
    });
    const pm = new PMREMGenerator(gl);
    const env = pm.fromScene(new RoomEnvironment(), 0.04).texture;
    return { hemi, moon, mt, spot, st, pts, env };
  }, [gl]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    scene.environment = rig.env;
    scene.background = new Color(s.bg);
    if (!(scene.fog instanceof FogExp2)) scene.fog = new FogExp2(s.fog.color, s.fog.density);
    (scene.fog as FogExp2).color.set(s.fog.color);
    (scene.fog as FogExp2).density = s.fog.density;
    scene.environmentIntensity = s.env;

    rig.hemi.color.set(s.hemi.sky);
    rig.hemi.groundColor.set(s.hemi.ground);
    rig.hemi.intensity = s.hemi.i;

    // moon: fixed frustum fitted around the shot box in light space
    const { min, max } = s.moon.box;
    const L = new Vector3(...s.moon.dir).normalize();
    const c = new Vector3(...min).add(new Vector3(...max)).multiplyScalar(0.5);
    rig.mt.position.copy(c);
    rig.mt.updateMatrixWorld();
    rig.moon.position.copy(c).addScaledVector(L, 120);
    const view = new Matrix4().lookAt(rig.moon.position, c, Math.abs(L.y) > 0.98 ? new Vector3(0, 0, 1) : new Vector3(0, 1, 0));
    const inv = new Matrix4().makeTranslation(rig.moon.position.x, rig.moon.position.y, rig.moon.position.z).multiply(view).invert();
    const lo = new Vector3(Infinity, Infinity, Infinity), hi = new Vector3(-Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity);
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
      const p = new Vector3(k & 1 ? max[0] : min[0], k & 2 ? max[1] : min[1], k & 4 ? max[2] : min[2]).applyMatrix4(inv);
      lo.min(p);
      hi.max(p);
    }
    const sc = rig.moon.shadow.camera;
    sc.left = lo.x; sc.right = hi.x; sc.bottom = lo.y; sc.top = hi.y;
    sc.near = Math.max(0.5, -hi.z - 5);
    sc.far = -lo.z + 5;
    sc.updateProjectionMatrix();
    rig.moon.color.set(s.moon.color);
    rig.moon.intensity = s.moon.i;
    // shadow maps render every frame even for a dark light: an unrendered shadow map makes WebGL
    // reject every draw call ("mismatch between texture format and sampler type")
    rig.moon.shadow.autoUpdate = true;

    rig.spot.position.set(...s.spot.pos);
    rig.st.position.set(...s.spot.target);
    rig.st.updateMatrixWorld();
    rig.spot.color.set(s.spot.color);
    rig.spot.intensity = s.spot.i;
    rig.spot.angle = s.spot.angle;
    rig.spot.penumbra = s.spot.penumbra;
    rig.spot.distance = s.spot.dist;
    rig.spot.decay = 2;
    rig.spot.shadow.camera.far = s.spot.dist;
    rig.spot.shadow.autoUpdate = true;

    s.pts.forEach((p, i) => {
      const l = rig.pts[i];
      l.position.set(...p.pos);
      l.color.set(p.color);
      l.intensity = p.i;
      l.distance = p.dist;
      l.decay = 2;
    });
  }, [s, rig, scene]);

  return (
    <>
      <primitive object={rig.hemi} />
      <primitive object={rig.moon} />
      <primitive object={rig.mt} />
      <primitive object={rig.spot} />
      <primitive object={rig.st} />
      {rig.pts.map((p, i) => (
        <primitive key={i} object={p} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
};

==== 2822 src/kits/characterflow/render/looks.ts
// Blending of light states and grades (scene moods change continuously: lamp off, alarm, calm).

import { Color } from "three";
import type { Grade } from "./FilmPost.tsx";
import type { LightState, PointL } from "./Lights.tsx";
import type { V3 } from "../character/spec.ts";

const mixN = (a: number, b: number, k: number) => a + (b - a) * k;
const mix3 = (a: V3, b: V3, k: number): V3 => [mixN(a[0], b[0], k), mixN(a[1], b[1], k), mixN(a[2], b[2], k)];
const _a = new Color(), _b = new Color();
const mixC = (a: string, b: string, k: number) => `#${_a.set(a).lerp(_b.set(b), k).getHexString()}`;
const mixP = (a: PointL, b: PointL, k: number): PointL => {
  // a light fading in/out keeps its position (no sliding across the room)
  const pos = a.i === 0 ? b.pos : b.i === 0 ? a.pos : mix3(a.pos, b.pos, k);
  return { pos, color: mixC(a.color, b.color, k), i: mixN(a.i, b.i, k), dist: mixN(a.dist, b.dist, k) };
};

export const mixLight = (a: LightState, b: LightState, k: number): LightState => {
  if (k <= 0) return a;
  if (k >= 1) return b;
  return {
    bg: mixC(a.bg, b.bg, k),
    fog: { color: mixC(a.fog.color, b.fog.color, k), density: mixN(a.fog.density, b.fog.density, k) },
    env: mixN(a.env, b.env, k),
    hemi: { sky: mixC(a.hemi.sky, b.hemi.sky, k), ground: mixC(a.hemi.ground, b.hemi.ground, k), i: mixN(a.hemi.i, b.hemi.i, k) },
    moon: { dir: mix3(a.moon.dir, b.moon.dir, k), box: a.moon.box, color: mixC(a.moon.color, b.moon.color, k), i: mixN(a.moon.i, b.moon.i, k) },
    spot: a.spot.i === 0 ? { ...b.spot, i: b.spot.i * k } : b.spot.i === 0 ? { ...a.spot, i: a.spot.i * (1 - k) } : { ...b.spot, i: mixN(a.spot.i, b.spot.i, k) },
    pts: [0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => mixP(a.pts[i], b.pts[i], k)) as LightState["pts"],
  };
};

export const mixGrade = (a: Grade, b: Grade, k: number): Grade => {
  if (k <= 0) return a;
  if (k >= 1) return b;
  const o = { ...a };
  for (const key of Object.keys(a) as (keyof Grade)[]) {
    const va = a[key], vb = b[key];
    if (typeof va === "number" && typeof vb === "number") (o as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = mixN(va, vb, k);
    else if (Array.isArray(va) && Array.isArray(vb)) (o as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = mix3(va as V3, vb as V3, k);
    else if (typeof va === "string" && typeof vb === "string") (o as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = mixC(va, vb, k);
  }
  return o;
};

/** Piecewise timeline of keyed states with smooth blends: [[t, state, blendSeconds], …]. */
export const keyed = <S,>(keys: [number, S, number][], mix: (a: S, b: S, k: number) => S, t: number): S => {
  let cur = keys[0][1];
  for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {
    const [t0, s, d] = keys[i];
    if (t < t0) break;
    const k = d <= 0 ? 1 : Math.min(1, (t - t0) / d);
    const e = k * k * (3 - 2 * k);
    cur = mix(cur, s, e);
  }
  return cur;
};

==== 1361 src/kits/characterflow/timing/cues.ts
// Voice-over cues: scenes refer to words of the transcript ("the lamp clicks off on *mati*") instead of
// seconds, so a re-recorded voice-over only needs a new transcript — the acting re-times itself.

export type Word = [text: string, start: number, end: number];

const norm = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, "");

export type Cues = {
  /** film time of a word (n = occurrence, 0-based); throws if the word is missing */
  at: (word: string, n?: number, edge?: "start" | "end") => number;
  end: (word: string, n?: number) => number;
  /** film time of the k-th word overall */
  word: (k: number) => number;
  words: Word[];
  offset: number;
  voEnd: number;
};

export const makeCues = (words: Word[], offset: number): Cues => {
  const find = (w: string, n = 0) => {
    const key = norm(w);
    let k = -1;
    for (let i = 0, seen = 0; i < words.length; i++)
      if (norm(words[i][0]) === key) {
        if (seen === n) { k = i; break; }
        seen++;
      }
    if (k < 0) throw new Error(`cue "${w}" #${n} not in transcript`);
    return words[k];
  };
  return {
    at: (w, n = 0, edge = "start") => offset + find(w, n)[edge === "start" ? 1 : 2],
    end: (w, n = 0) => offset + find(w, n)[2],
    word: (k) => offset + words[k][1],
    words,
    offset,
    voEnd: offset + words[words.length - 1][2],
  };
};
